added.title: Director of Engineering - Institutional Risk Technology
added.description:
Our client is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead a growing Institutional Engineering organization focused on delivering innovative risk and analytics solutions for institutional investors. This role will oversee multiple engineering teams and engineering leaders, with approximately 20-25 direct and indirect reports, while partnering closely with Product, Go-to-Market, and client-facing stakeholders to deliver complex, enterprise-grade solutions. The ideal candidate will come from an investment bank, asset manager, hedge fund, private equity firm, fintech, market data provider, or risk technology company and possess deep expertise in Credit Risk and/or Market Risk platforms, financial risk frameworks, and institutional investment workflows. This position requires a strong technical leader with architectural depth, organizational leadership experience, and the ability to engage directly with sophisticated institutional clients.
New York City, NY (Hybrid, 2-3 Days Per Week)
Compensation: $250,000 - $330,000 Base + Annual Bonus + Equity
The client can not sponsor at this time - only US Citizens or Green Card holders should apply.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering organization supporting institutional investment solutions
Manage engineering managers, architects, and software engineering teams across multiple initiatives
Establish engineering goals, operating metrics, and delivery processes that drive execution and accountability
Partner with senior leaders across Engineering, Product Management, and Go-to-Market functions to define strategy and execution plans
Build and scale teams capable of delivering business-critical capabilities for institutional investors

Product & Technology Leadership

Drive the technical vision, architecture, and execution of institutional risk and analytics products
Lead the integration of third-party risk technology platforms into a broader enterprise ecosystem
Collaborate with Product and client stakeholders to define and prioritize strategic roadmaps
Guide architectural decisions across cloud-native platforms, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems
Champion engineering excellence through modern development practices, automation, observability, security, and continuous delivery

Client & Business Partnership

Serve as a senior engineering leader in discussions with institutional clients, prospects, and strategic partners
Translate complex investment and risk management requirements into scalable technology solutions
Work closely with some of the largest investment organizations globally to ensure successful product adoption and delivery
Help shape products that support sophisticated institutional investment and risk management workflows

Required Qualifications:

Required Experience

10+ years of software engineering experience with significant leadership responsibility
Director-level leadership experience or demonstrated readiness to step into a Director role
Experience managing large engineering organizations, including managers, architects, and software engineers
Proven success leading teams responsible for financial risk frameworks, risk analytics, or institutional investment technology
Deep domain expertise in Credit Risk and/or Market Risk systems
Experience working within:
Investment Banks
Asset Managers
Hedge Funds
Private Equity Firms
FinTech Companies
Market Data Providers (Bloomberg, ICAP/BrokerTec, or similar)
Risk Technology Platforms

Technical Background

Strong architectural expertise across modern cloud-native technologies
Experience with enterprise software platforms serving highly regulated financial institutions
Knowledge of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, data engineering, and security frameworks
Track record of delivering scalable, mission-critical financial applications

Leadership & Communication

Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills
Comfortable interacting directly with institutional clients and executive stakeholders
Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence across engineering, product, and commercial teams

added.title: Director of Engineering, Data Products
added.description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Data Products pillar, serving as the technical engine for Counterpart Health's (CPH) clinical-data foundation. You will own the technical strategy and execution for the Data Products roadmap—encompassing clinical data ingestion, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability—while building scalable, reusable data capabilities that serve as a foundational platform for driving clinical insight generation. You will own the technical strategy for our Data Products platform—ensuring our clinical data foundations (using standards like FHIR, LOINC, and RxNorm) effectively drive business outcomes. You will serve as a critical leader and partner to the VP of Engineering and cross-functional leaders in Product, Data Science, and Design.

As a Director Of Engineering, Data Products, You Will

Own the Data Products technical roadmap, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability.
Manage and optimize the clinical data ingestion pipeline.
Oversee the scaling of customer data onboarding processes and the continuous improvement of data hygiene, canonical storage standards, and observability and monitoring of the data pipelines.
Enable shared funnel visibility across the organization and support the development of a robust enterprise reporting framework.
Drive the adoption of an AI-powered Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), leveraging AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment processes while maintaining stringent code quality and security standards.

Success In This Role Looks Like

Successfully achieving improved clinical data coverage and freshness targets across all patient populations.
Predictable and repeatable multi-customer scaling with standardized playbooks for rapid data readiness.
Broad adoption of the Data Products platform and its capabilities
Data infrastructure is robust, stable, and serves as a reliable source of truth during rapid organizational growth and customer expansion.

You Should Get In Touch If

You possess 10+ years of engineering experience with a deep focus on building high-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, CCDA).
Proven track record in managing and scaling engineering teams that handle data-heavy workloads and complex clinical data pipelines.
Proven experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver complex software in regulated environments.
Experience implementing and scaling AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., AI code assistants, automated testing, or AI-driven SDLC) to improve engineering productivity.
Demonstrated experience building and managing engineering systems in highly regulated healthcare environments, with a strong operational understanding of HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance requirements.
Passionate about the healthcare sector and committed to utilizing technical expertise to drive meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
Deeply familiar with the inherent complexities and lack of standardization in clinical datasets, with a proactive focus on enhancing data integrity.
Motivated by intricate technical challenges and dedicated to architecting pragmatic, high-quality engineering solutions through continuous intellectual exploration.
Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments, demonstrating the ability to navigate ambiguity and align technical priorities with overarching strategic objectives.
Action-oriented leader who assumes full ownership of system sustainability, willing to address operational gaps to ensure the team achieves its delivery milestones.

Engineering Leadership Skills

Proven track record of directly hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering managers, Tech Leads (TLs), and Principal Engineers (PELs).
Demonstrated ability to cultivate a high-performance engineering culture focused on velocity, quality, and psychological safety.
Experience leading organizational change, including structural re-orgs and process evolution.
Strong proficiency in strategic resource allocation, capacity planning, and managing technical debt in a fast-paced product environment.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear, actionable business strategies (e.g., impact on HEDIS/RADV outcomes) for non-technical leadership.

Benefits Overview

Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks

Reimbursement for office setup expenses
Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
Paid parental leave for all new parents
And much more!

About Counterpart Health:
In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is:

$223,100—$290,000 USD

added.title: Director, Rack Scale Software Architecture
added.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA has a rapidly expanding ecosystem of data center platform & node designs. From single node HGX/DGX systems all the way up to large multi-node NVLink domain rack architectures. These designs have become core to NVIDIA's rapidly growing enterprise and cloud provider businesses. Each bringing together the full power of NVIDIA GPUs, NVIDIA NVLink, NVIDIA InfiniBand networking, NVIDIA Grace CPUs, and a fully optimized NVIDIA AI and HPC software stack. We're searching for a highly technical, motivated manager to lead & manage the team responsible for rack-scale system software architecture. From firmware, kernel drivers, operating systems, networking, fabrics and associated user mode drivers + manageability software. You will work with component leads internally and engage with industry leading hyperscalar / cloud service providers on taking these products to market.

What You’ll Be Doing

Drive the software end-to-end architecture for NVIDIA's rack-scale products
Maintain deep understanding of the product portfolio and roadmap; translate forward-looking plans into clear, formal software requirements that anchor execution across the organization.
Ensure high quality & reliable software; serving as a trusted architectural partner to teams requiring guidance or oversight.
Work directly with major customers to understand their requirements and work to align their roadmap with NVIDIA’s roadmap.
Using strong communication skills, present the team vision to senior NVIDIA and external leaders.
Provide technical leadership and career mentorship to the team
Make key technical decisions even when faced with ambiguity

What We Need To See

BS or MS degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related degree or equivalent experience.
15+ overall years of experience in the area of System architecture and design with 8+ yrs of proven experience in management
Deep experience in designing architecture for scalable and performant server systems, particularly at the SW/HW interface.
Proven leadership skills and strong ownership on past projects involving a large scale sophisticated code base
Previous experience working with complex system software for accelerators such as GPUs, DPUs, or FPGAs
Possess strong managerial, problem solving and critical thinking skills.
Comfortable operating in highly matrixed organizations while holding a leadership position
Known for your strong interactive, verbal and written communications skills

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Knowledge of large-scale cloud and cluster level deployment and management systems. Experience with designing robust, resilient and performant scale-up fabrics
Demonstrated track record of leading data center products across the entire lifecycle, spanning inception, pre-silicon development, post-silicon bring-up, manufacturing, and deployment.
Strong understanding of networking technology & protocols (e.g. Ethernet, Infiniband). Familiarity with CXL, UCIE and other C2C technology architectures. Knowledge in storage and networking technologies.

We are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, and as a result have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. So if you're clever, creative, and driven, we'd love to have you join the team.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

added.title: Beam Delivery Systems Engineering Department Head
added.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Linac Coherent Light Source (LCLS) Engineering Division at the SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is seeking a mechanical engineer to lead the Beam Delivery Systems Engineering Department.

LCLS is an X-ray Free Electron (FEL) facility, operated by Stanford University at the SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory, on behalf of the Department of Energy / Office of Science. This facility provides world-leading scientific capabilities to a global user community, covering a broad research portfolio that includes the development of advanced materials and chemical catalysts for clean energy systems; drug discovery for modern pharmaceuticals; and fundamental studies of astrophysical phenomena. Seven (7) independent instruments are specifically designed to utilize the unique beam characteristics of the LCLS to meet these scientific objectives.

The Beam Delivery Systems Engineering Department supports LCLS with mechanical engineers and engineering physicists. The department supports the design, operations, and maintenance of the X-ray beam paths to ensure systems meet experimental requirements and reliably deliver X-ray photons on target. This includes developing mechatronic and optomechanical systems to precisely control X-ray beam alignment, wavefront, and timing. And the design, characterization, and procurement of high-performance X-ray mirrors. This department operates off-line laboratories for advanced metrology of X-ray mirrors and new techniques to clean mirror coatings in situ.

As the head of the Beam Delivery Systems Engineering Department, in addition to engineering responsibilities, you will manage a team of engineers, provide supervision, guidance and training, foster staff development, promote engineering rigor, and participate in hiring activities to support the LCLS mission. This position administratively reports to the LCLS Engineering Division Leader within the LCLS Directorate.

Your Specific Responsibilities Include

Provide engineering leadership for new initiatives that advances advance X-ray experimental capabilities through delivery of complex scientific instrumentation, X-ray and laser system opto-mechanical systems, experiment and beamline diagnostics, and target delivery systems.
Provide engineering leadership for the integration and testing of systems and devices, working with staff scientists, fabrication facilities and personnel, and technicians.
Responsible for the execution and delivery of technical scope, within budget and on schedule, with a high degree of quality assurance using standardized engineering processes.
May function as a Cost Account Manager (CAM) in project management roles.
Promote adherence to the LCLS Conduct of Engineering, ensuring engineering rigor with accurate documentation and engineering review.
Provide the department with leadership in project engineering to support system development, integration, commissioning and the effective transfer of new capabilities to operations.
Prepare and conduct performance management activities for department personnel and contribute to the LCLS engineering ranking and salary management processes.
Influence strategic technical decisions made by LCLS senior management.
Contribute to the definition of complex engineering solutions for X-ray based experiments.
Perform engineering duties requiring significant scheduling and budgeting responsibility.

To Be Successful In This Position You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field and at least eight years of experience with the design and operation of beam delivery systems.
Leadership, interpersonal skills, organizational, and supervisory skills to lead personnel, write performance appraisals, and actively participate in ranking and hiring activities.
Experience with engineering tools such as Solid Edge, ANSYS and/or MATLAB.
Ability to promote and maintain productive relationships across LCLS and SLAC.
Expert communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills, necessary to present, explain, and advise LCLS senior management and/or external sponsors.
Experience working independently and responsively to changing priorities and ability to meet deadlines
Manufacturing, assembly, and installation coordination of complex systems.
Exercising sound engineering judgment.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a diverse team environment.

In Addition, Preferred Requirements Include

An advanced degree and experience with scientific instrumentation, project management, and/or technical supervision.
Experience in X-ray FEL, synchrotron, metrology, and/or laser system engineering.
Experience with user facilities and/or national laboratories.
Formal training/experience in systems engineering processes and methodologies

Summary

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leader who has consistently demonstrated establishing or leading research programs, projects, groups, or mission critical systems that are essential to meeting the scientific and operational goals of the laboratory.

Scope Of Impact

Provides leadership identifying, promoting, and developing core laboratory capabilities, influencing future scientific or technicaldirection of the laboratory.

Delivers research or technology objectives with high distinction.

Knowledge And Expertise

Generates and develops advanced scientific or technical capabilities in a broad field of knowledge for several applications and has fully demonstrated grasp of related disciplines.

Consistently leads focused research, technologies, design, or facility operations with creativity and innovation.

Demonstrated excellence in communicating research progress to both internal and external audiences.

Directing Others/Supervision

Demonstrated ability to build and lead effective teams and to actively mentor staff.

Program Development

Generates new applications, programs or proposals and leads their development.

Generates solutions to key technical or scientific challenges critical to program/project success.

Minimum Education And Experience Required

BS in applicable engineering or scientific discipline and 8 years of relevant experience

About Us

SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory explores how the universe works at the biggest, smallest and fastest scales and invents powerful tools used by researchers around the globe. As world leaders in ultrafast science and bold explorers of the physics of the universe, we forge new ground in understanding our origins and building a healthier and more sustainable future. Our discovery and innovation help develop new materials and chemical processes and open unprecedented views of the cosmos and life’s most delicate machinery. Building on more than 60 years of visionary research, we help shape the future by advancing areas such as quantum technology, scientific computing and the development of next-generation accelerators.

SLAC is operated by Stanford University for the U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Science . The Office of Science is the single largest supporter of basic research in the physical sciences in the United States and is working to address some of the most pressing challenges of our time.

The job duties listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classifications and are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks and responsibilities. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary depending on department or program needs without changing the general nature and scope of the job or level of responsibility. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of their job.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetic information. All staff at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory must be able to demonstrate the legal right to work in the United States. SLAC is an E-Verify employer.

As a national laboratory, SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is responsible for adhering to the Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which require employees to obtain and maintain a HSPD-12 Personal Identify Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. The tier of federal background investigation will be determined by job duties and national security or public trust responsibilities associated with the job. All tiers of investigation include a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last 1 to 7 years (depending on the applicable tier of investigation). Illegal drug activities include marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

For Foreign National Candidates

If you have not resided in the U.S. for three consecutive years, you are not eligible for the PIV credential and instead will need to obtain a favorable Local Site Specific Only (LSSO) Federal risk determination to maintain employment. Once you meet the three-year residency requirement, you will be required to obtain a PIV credential to maintain employment. The tier of federal background investigation required to obtain the PIV credential will be determined by job duties at the time you become eligible for the PIV credential.

added.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Founded through Flagship Pioneering’s venture creation engine, Terrana Biosciences is a cutting-edge agricultural biotechnology company developing innovative RNA-based products to address global agricultural challenges. We are committed to advancing sustainable farming solutions through precision technologies that ensure environmental safety and regulatory compliance.

THE ROLE

Terrana is seeking a Director, Data & Technology to develop and lead the company-wide capabilities that convert data, software, ML/AI and IT into dependable scientific, operational and business outcomes. Reporting to the VP, Strategy and Operations, the Director will develop and execute an integrated strategy for Data Engineering, IT, software and ML/AI development and deployment. The position will lead 3-5 direct reports and coordinate external vendors, consultants and contractors, set clear priorities, and drive delivery of high-quality outcomes.

Functional Scope:

Data Engineering–establishment and governance of FAIR data, resilient data systems, and cost-effective infrastructure
IT–management of business systems, access, cybersecurity, and vendors
Software and ML/AI Deployment–identification, prioritization and selection of highest impact tools, productionization, integration, support, and adoption
Targeted Software Development -of bespoke, internal tools; workflow automation and integrations for high-value company requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and execute a company-wide data strategy and associated execution plan in support of Terrana's strategic priorities
Lead, coach and manage a multidisciplinary team of 3-5 direct reports, with additional oversight of contractors, consultants and service providers.
Establish clear roles, goals, development plans and performance expectations, and create a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence and reliable delivery
Convert stakeholder needs into well-defined projects; ensuring work is delivered on time and to specification
Lead the evolution of Terrana's data architecture and engineering capabilities, including cloud data platforms, data models, pipelines,APIs and integrations across all systems. Ensure FAIR data
Establish and enforce appropriate data governance, security and lifecycle policies and practices
Partner with software engineers, ML/AI scientists, computational biologists and domain scientists to deploy software and models into dependable production workflows. Oversee integration, testing, validation, versioning, CI/CD or MLOps, observability and ongoing performance management
Oversee bespoke software development and workflow automation where required, following clear build/buy/partner evaluations
Provide reliable and secure IT services through internal resources and external providers, including identity and access, endpoints, business applications, service support, and cybersecurity
Serve as the primary senior-leadership interface for the Data function, engaging leadership on strategy, execution progress, decisions, tradeoffs, risks and resource needs, and establishment of steering and decision forums
Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize systems and services

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, information systems, bioinformatics or related discipline; an advanced degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred
10+ years of progressive experience across data engineering, software, digital platforms, ML/AI enablement or IT
Demonstrated success developing and executing a technical strategy
Proven ability to manage direct reports, as well as consultants and service providers
Strong technical grounding in cloud-based data architecture and engineering, including data modeling, databases, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, integrations, accesscontrolsand observability; AWS experience is preferred
Experience deploying and operating production software and ML/AI-enabled workflows
Working knowledge of enterprise IT operations, cybersecurity, identity and access management, and SaaS administration
Experience supporting scientific, R&D or other technically complex workflows
Consistent track record of delivering high-quality outcomes on time and to specification
Excellent leadership presence, communication and stakeholder-management skills

Preferred Experience:

Experience with Benchling or another LIMS
Experience applying generative AI, workflow automation or AI-native tools

LOCATION:
Durham, NC (strongly preferred) or Cambridge, MA

ABOUT FLAGSHIP PIONEERING:

Flagship Pioneering invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. Many of these companies have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer
. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We recognize that great candidates often bring unique strengths without fulfilling every qualification
. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your background and interest in Flagship.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies
: Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, “FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to FSP or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

The salary range for this role is $182,000 - $240,000. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. Terrana Biosciences, Inc. currently offers healthcare coverage, annual incentive program, retirement benefits and a broad range of other benefits. Compensation and benefits information is based on Terrana Biosciences, Inc.'s good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

Privacy Notice for Applicants:
When you apply for a role at Flagship Pioneering or one of its portfolio companies, we collect and use personal information you provide (such as your name, contact details, work history, and application materials) to evaluate your application, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. Your application data is processed through Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system, and may also be reviewed using AI-assisted screening tools. We do not sell your personal information. California residents have rights under the CCPA/CPRA including to know, delete, and opt out of the sharing of their personal information. If you are located in the EU or UK, we process your data under GDPR and you have rights to access, rectify, and erase your data. To exercise your rights or for questions, contact privacy@flagshippioneering.com.

Overview

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

The Role and Team

The Head of Data Platform & Engineering owns our internal enterprise data strategy and platform, turning raw operational data into governed, trusted data products that power decision-making for our executive leadership team (ELT), FP&A, GTM Analytics and other business functions within Medallia. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with demonstrated experience in defining a data strategy, executing on the platform architecture and data modeling, and building and coaching a small team of data engineers and analysts. This role will also lead the effort to extend self-service analytics beyond a small group of expert Tableau users to a broader, distributed set of business analysts by leveraging the newer breed of analytics solutions and AI.

This role sits at the center of how we operate as one integrated, high-performing company: the data platform is the connective tissue that gives leadership a single source of truth on the health of the business, and gives go-to-market teams (Marketing, Sales, Service, and Support) the insight they need to protect and grow our customer base.

Responsibilities

Own and evolve the enterprise data strategy and technical architecture for the enterprise data platform, continuing our shift to a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture.
Build a deep working knowledge of the company's GTM strategy, product telemetry, and financial reporting needs; act as a trusted advisor to business functions, translating their priorities into well-governed data products and a prioritized roadmap.
Partner with business function leaders and their distributed analytics teams to gather requirements, prioritize the backlog, and run an agile delivery model with a clear bias to action.
Provide hands-on leadership and coaching to a small team of data engineers and analysts, reviewing data models and pipelines and unblocking technical decisions.
Define and maintain data governance standards — quality, access, lineage, and shared definitions — in partnership with data owners across the business.
Lead the evaluation and rollout of tools that extend self-service analytics and AI enablement to non-technical business users, reducing reliance on multiple Excel workbooks and avoiding the learning curve of more complex BI solutions.
Partner cross-functionally on data initiatives that support revenue growth: pipeline generation, prospecting, expansion and renewal (ATR) opportunities, rep productivity, and product telemetry - bringing greater predictability and insight to the business.
Lead the selection, implementation, and management of the core data platform technology stack; partner with business functions on selection and management of the analytics and visualization tools that leverage the data platform.
Identify opportunities to apply AI to the data platform itself and to internal reporting and analytics workflows, in line with the company's broader AI-enablement priorities.

Candidates based in the Tysons vicinity will be prioritized as this role is Hybrid, 3 days per week onsite.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years in data engineering and/or data platform management, including 5+ years leading a data platform, data engineering, and/or analytics team.
Hands-on experience and proficiency in SQL and dbt (or a comparable transformation and orchestration solution) to transform raw source data into analysis-ready, governed tables and views.
Demonstrated experience architecting and operating cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse) at enterprise scale, leveraging pipeline orchestration (e.g., Dagster, Airflow, or similar) and EL / ETL tooling (e.g., Fivetran or similar).
Experience designing and executing a data platform strategy end to end — from technical architecture, through data governance, to business adoption.
Track record of translating ambiguous business requirements into clear data models, metrics, and reporting.
Experience running an agile delivery model with a bias to action and a track record of shipping incremental business value.
Strong communication, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills; comfortable operating as a trusted advisor to executive and business-function leaders, not just a service provider, in a dynamic environment.
Proven people leadership: hiring, coaching, and developing a small, senior technical team.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) or similar layered data architecture.
Experience with Tableau and with newer spreadsheet-native, self-service BI tools (e.g., Sigma, Omni) — particularly in extending BI to non-technical business analysts.
Familiarity with native AI/ML capabilities within a cloud data platform (e.g., Snowflake Cortex) and a passion for leveraging AI to accelerate data engineering and analytics work.
Experience in a B2B software/SaaS company, ideally supporting FP&A, GTM (marketing, sales, service/support), and executive data and reporting use cases.
Ability to distill signal from noise in large, messy data sets and crisply communicate the "so what" to non-technical executive audiences.

We’re a low-ego, collaborative team of curious problem-solvers who care about building well-crafted products and solving difficult technical problems. Our engineering team supports both established commercial products and a growing portfolio of defense programs, including actively funded development work.

We’re looking for a Vice President of Engineering to lead our engineering organization and own how product direction becomes successful engineering execution. This is a hardware engineering leadership role, and we’re looking for someone who is hardware-first but software-competent
—a leader with deep experience developing physical products who also understands the software and embedded systems that bring them to life.

We are specifically looking for someone whose career has been grounded in electrical engineering, hardware engineering, embedded systems, or the development of complex physical products. You must have previously taken hardware from requirements and architecture through prototype, validation, manufacturing, and production. 

You’ll directly lead a multidisciplinary team of approximately ten engineers and work closely with our CEO, engineering leads, Program Management, and Project Management.

Your job will be to translate overall product direction and decisions from the CEO into clear technical requirements and plans to build products with a talented team.

What You’ll Own

Engineering Leadership
Directly lead, manage, and develop our engineering team across electrical/hardware, RF, FPGA, embedded systems, software, AI/ML, and related disciplines.
Stay close enough to the work to understand what each engineer is working on, how they are performing, and where they need support.
Establish meaningful engineering goals and KPIs and hold the team accountable for results.
Conduct regular 1:1s, annual performance reviews, and ongoing coaching and professional development. Additionally, identify future engineering resource needs and recruit talent. 

Engineering Execution
Translate product direction from CEO into clear, measurable engineering requirements and technical targets, as well as ensure the right engineers are assigned to the right projects
Collaborate with the team to provide reliable estimates for engineering effort, hardware cost, development timelines, and technical risk.
Recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complicated and help the team find the simplest solution that meets the requirement.
 Partner closely with Program and Project Management to keep engineering execution predictable and accountable.

Technical & Hardware Leadership
Own the full hardware product lifecycle, from initial concept and design through testing, validation, release, and ongoing post-launch support, as well as the establishment of quality and testing standards.
Provide strong technical judgment across multidisciplinary product development.
Lead technical and architectural reviews while effectively challenging and supporting engineers who may have deeper expertise in individual disciplines.
  Understand complex digital and mixed signal system designs 
 Develop appropriate technical gates and review processes from concept through production.
Ensure designs appropriately balance performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, schedule, and complexity.

 Create an effective feedback and approval process between Engineering and company leadership.
Turn product goals into realistic technical targets for cost, schedule, performance, and resources.
Surface risks and constraints early rather than allowing engineering problems to become business surprises.
Present leadership with clear technical tradeoffs and recommendations.

Who You’ll Work With
At Slalom, we blend personal connection with global scale to transform how organizations redefine possibilities, shape the future, and achieve their goals. Our mission is to maximize the value of the technology and software our clients create through efficient, high-quality, and consistent service, incorporating AI tools and outcome-focused strategies across the product lifecycle.
As a senior leader level within our Cloud and Build capability in the Americas, you will operate as part of a broader go-to-market leadership network. The role drives sales, delivery, and client outcomes across product engineering and cloud modernization, supporting clients as they build, scale, and operate digital products and platforms. A requirement of this role is residency within the assigned market.
What You’ll Do
This role will align regional Capability strategies with market needs by acting as a subject matter expert and thought leader. You will collaborate closely with clients and industry partners to identify opportunities. Additionally, you will support and develop a go-to-market team, contribute to delivery through billable roles with specific utilization targets, and partner with leadership to achieve revenue goals and address capability challenges.
Capability Vision and Strategy

Tailors regional capability strategy to market needs.
Ensures our Product Engineering and Cloud capabilities align with desired client outcomes.

Delivery Management

Engages in billable client delivery roles, ensuring high-quality outcomes in product engineering and cloud modernization

Go to Market Approach

Ignites awareness and demand for Product Engineering and Cloud offerings through campaigns, RFIs, RFPs, workshops, and POCs.
Builds and sustains relationships across target and active client portfolios in your market.
Creates demand by proactively seeking speaking opportunities within the geographic Market as a Capability SME and thought leader at external conferences and events.

Business Development and Sales

Partners with client and sales leaders to identify technology-led opportunities, acting as the Solution Lead or Subject Matter Expert during pursuits.
Participates in multi-capability solutioning and outcome-based selling motions with other Go To market leaders.
Collaborates on growth projections, driving revenue performance against forecasts and identify capability health challenges, aligning corrective actions as needed.
Be responsible for an individual P&L target.

Resource Pipeline

Participates in hiring, staffing, and workforce planning rhythms for market and or capability teams.

People Development

Leads and develops teams through direct and indirect reporting relationships to scale go-to-market impact.
Provides performance feedback on Capability team members supporting pursuits and delivery.

What You’ll Bring
You possess deep technology delivery and leadership experience, with a passion for building teams and client partnerships. You are skilled as both a strategic leader and hands-on practitioner, with expertise in product engineering, cloud operations, AI-accelerated engineering, and large-scale delivery models. Your leadership is inspirational and proactive, with a strong emphasis on collaboration, growth, and market-focused strategic thinking.
Core Expertise:

Product Engineering: Extensive experience leading cross-discipline teams (Agile, Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, DevOps, and UX).
Cloud & Modern Operations: Experience with modern operations (SRE) and working with top partners like AWS, Microsoft, and Google to co-sell or deliver.
Accelerated Engineering with AI: Deep understanding of how Generative AI is evolving the SDLC and maturing technology organizations.
Team-Based Delivery at Scale: Experience delivering engineering projects using scale teaming models, including Nearshore and Offshore partners.
Product Mindset: Ability to work with customers to shape product strategy, roadmaps, and outcome-based results.
Leadership Attributes:
Inspirational Leadership: Forward-looking strategic thinking connected to market needs.
Proactive GTM Mentality: A builder of relationships and pipeline who does not wait for leads to be handed to them.
Collaboration: Strong ability to collaborate across different teams and global organizations.
Grow Mindset: Acts as an external speaker at events and speaks to customer CXOs as a peer with credibility and confidence.

About Us
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. 
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 
Compensation and Benefits
Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.
Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges:  The targeted base salary pay range for this role is $200,000 to $250,000. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus .  Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.    
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at:  peopleone@slalom.com . Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose.
EEO and Accommodations
Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact  accomodationrequest@slalom.com  if you require accommodations during the interview process.

added.title: Senior Vice President of Engineering
added.description:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Vice President of Engineering to lead Koalafi’s entire engineering organization, including our Consumer and Merchant Experience, Core Engineering, and Application Experience groups, as well as our Data & AI Platform and Architecture functions.

Reporting to the Chief Product and Technology Officer, you will partner closely with the CPTO and Head of Product to set engineering direction, translate company priorities into execution, and build an organization that delivers meaningful business results. Your scope spans the platforms, applications, services, and data infrastructure that power our customer experiences, merchant relationships, and internal operations.

This is a company leadership role, not solely an engineering leadership role. You will help shape business decisions, influence across functions, and bring a clear perspective on how technology can support growth, improve efficiency, and strengthen the customer experience. You must be equally credible in a technical discussion with engineers and a strategic discussion with the executive team or the board—and move comfortably between those two modes.

We’re also looking for an active AI practitioner who will help evolve how Koalafi works. You should be building and experimenting with AI tools yourself, with a thoughtful perspective on how to apply them across engineering and the broader business. The goal is not simply to increase adoption of tools or token usage, but to drive real, measurable business outcomes by embracing a willingness to fundamentally change how the business operates. You will lead this transformation through practical application, sound judgment, and measurable results.

What You’ll Do

Set engineering direction and own execution

Partner with the CPTO, Head of Product, and cross-functional leaders to translate company objectives into a clear engineering strategy, investment priorities, and execution plans. Ensure teams understand the outcomes they are accountable for, make realistic commitments, and surface risks and tradeoffs early. Own the engineering response when delivery is at risk, aligning leaders on corrective action and following through.

Lead as a business executive

Build strong partnerships across Product, Risk, Operations, Finance, Sales, and other functions. Contribute to company decisions beyond engineering, connecting technical choices to growth, customer experience, operating efficiency, and risk. Communicate complex topics clearly and bring well-vetted recommendations – not simply issues or requests – to executive discussions.

Apply technical depth with sound leadership judgment

Earn the team’s trust through technical expertise, thoughtful questions, and the ability to engage deeply in consequential architectural and engineering decisions. Recognize when an initiative, technical risk, or team challenge needs your direct involvement, and engage early enough to make a difference. Balance that involvement with clear delegation, strengthening your leaders’ ownership rather than becoming a bottleneck or doing their jobs for them.

Build and develop a strong leadership team

Lead, coach, and hold accountable engineering leaders and managers across the organization. Set clear expectations for their technical judgment, business understanding, people leadership, and execution. Invest in succession planning, leadership development, and hiring, while addressing performance gaps directly. Continually evaluate team structure, responsibilities, and leadership capacity so the organization can operate effectively as priorities evolve.

Own architecture, data foundations, and pragmatic modernization

Guide the evolution of our applications, core services, and data platforms, balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability, reliability, and scale. Modernize the tech stack where it creates clear business value and be able to defend the ROI. Partner with Risk, Analytics, and Data Science to ensure our data engineering and AI foundations support reliable access, clear ownership, and effective use of data across the company.

Drive engineering excellence and responsible investment

Strengthen quality, test automation, delivery practices, observability, and operational readiness. Establish useful measures of delivery effectiveness, reliability, cost, and business impact, and use them to guide improvement. Own engineering budget and capacity planning in partnership with the CPTO and Finance, challenging staffing and technology proposals against business needs and credible alternatives. Partner closely with IT and Information Security to build and operate secure, resilient systems.

Lead AI adoption through hands-on practice

Maintain an active practice of building, prototyping, and experimenting with AI tools yourself. Use that experience to help teams improve how they design, build, test, deploy, and operate software—not just how they write code. Stay current with emerging capabilities, distinguish useful advances from hype, and turn promising experiments into repeatable practices with measurable improvements in speed, quality, or capacity, with the ultimate goal being to drive better business outcomes for the company.

Help the broader company work more effectively through AI

Partner with business leaders to identify where generative AI, automation, and better internal tools can improve workflows and outcomes. Help teams move from ideas and pilots to solutions people actually use. Ensure adoption is supported by appropriate data access, technical foundations, training, and safeguards, in partnership with Information Security, Risk, and Legal and Compliance.

About You

An experienced engineering executive.
You bring 15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including substantial experience leading managers and senior engineering leaders across multiple teams. You have owned organization-wide strategy, delivery, talent, and investment decisions, not just an individual product or technical function.
Technically credible and comfortable going deep.
You have strong architectural judgment across complex applications, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms. You can challenge assumptions, assess tradeoffs, and help teams work through difficult technical decisions without needing to be the expert in every technology.
Business-minded and influential across functions.
You understand how engineering decisions affect revenue, cost, customer experience, and risk. You can earn the confidence of executive peers, navigate competing priorities, and build alignment without relying on reporting lines or authority.
A leader with strong situational judgment.
You know when to delegate, when to coach, when to challenge, and when to get directly involved. You maintain enough visibility to recognize emerging problems and take ownership before they become escalations, without micromanaging your team.
A committed developer of leaders.
You have a track record of building inclusive, high-performing organizations and helping managers become stronger leaders. You set a high bar, provide candid feedback, address difficult people decisions, and create clear accountability.
An active AI practitioner.
You can point to things you have personally built, workflows you have redesigned, or experiments you have run using AI tools. You have informed views on their capabilities and limitations, and experience helping others apply them effectively. Your interest extends beyond coding productivity to how AI can improve the way an entire company operates.
Pragmatic and accountable for outcomes.
You can balance modernization with delivery, speed with reliability, and ambition with available capacity. You communicate clearly, make decisions with imperfect information, and follow through on commitments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or other regulated, transaction-intensive environments is a plus, as is experience with customer- and merchant-facing products, servicing platforms, and internal business systems such as Salesforce.
Familiarity with technologies in our environment—including Go, Node.js, React, AWS, Kubernetes, and native iOS and Android development—is helpful. We value strong engineering fundamentals and architectural judgment over expertise in any single stack.
Fluency in the modern AI stack and in how it is changing the way software is built. That includes frontier models, coding agents, and the harnesses, evaluations, and guardrails that make them reliable in production. You should understand how the developer workflow is shifting from writing code to designing and supervising agentic loops, where agents plan, build, test, and verify work against clear specifications. We standardize on Claude, but regularly evaluate new frontier models and tools, and knowing which advances actually matter, is a core part of the job.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location:
Richmond, VA; Arlington, VA; or Remote (U.S.). Associates near one of our office locations may work in-office, hybrid, or remotely. Remote opportunities are available to candidates throughout the United States.

Salary Range:
$275,000-$325,000 per year (depending on experience and location)

Additional Compensation:
This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.
The final salary offer will depend on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and geographic location. The actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

Applications will be accepted until position is filled.

Why choose Koalafi:
A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.

Benefits:

At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
20 PTO days + 11 paid holidays
401(k) retirement with company matching
Student Loan & Tuition Reimbursement
Commuter assistance
Parental leave (maternal + paternal)
Inclusion and Associate Engagement Programs

Who we are & what we value:

We focus on what’s most important
We set clear expectations and deliver
We embrace challenges to reach our full potential
We ask, “How can this be better?”
We move fast together

added.description:
Job Description

BNY is seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Director, Security Engineering Lead
. This role is responsible for establishing and evolving global physical security design standards across BNY locations, ensuring alignment with industry best practices, changing threat landscapes, regulatory expectations, and enterprise design requirements. The position will lead the development of security design standards for physical controls, access control, video monitoring, and specialized secure spaces, while partnering closely with internal stakeholders and third parties involved in office design, construction, and renovation.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure BNY physical security design remains aligned with industry best practices and continues to evolve in response to the global threat landscape.
Develop and maintain standards for physical security controls, including doors and hardware, turnstiles, gates, fences, vehicle barriers, and similar controls, in a manner that addresses threat exposure while supporting BNY aesthetic expectations.
Create and maintain standards for access control systems and video monitoring across BNY-occupied locations.
Design specialized security solutions and technical specifications to address unique security, operational, and audit requirements for special-use rooms and sensitive spaces.
Manage and oversee the security design of new office projects and office remodels in partnership with third-party architects, engineers, consultants, and vendors to ensure BNY standards are consistently achieved.
Review design options for BNY offices with a focus on Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED) principles, partnering with architects and design teams to enhance employee and visitor safety.
Collaborate with Facilities and related partners to ensure physical security design properly incorporates and addresses broader facilities security concerns.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies, design approaches, and solutions to improve the effectiveness and maturity of BNY physical security.
Work with appropriate third parties to ensure all BNY security designs comply with applicable national, regional, and local code requirements.
Ensure all designs submitted to Construction Project Management comply with BNY physical security standards and requirements.
Serve as the primary point of contact for physical security design-related matters, providing subject matter expertise and guidance across projects and stakeholders.

Qualifications

Significant experience in physical security design, architecture, engineering, construction, or a related discipline, with leadership responsibility across multiple sites or regions.
Strong knowledge of physical security systems and controls, including perimeter security, access control, video surveillance, and protective design measures.
Demonstrated experience developing enterprise standards and technical design specifications for physical security environments.
Knowledge of CPTED principles and their practical application in workplace and corporate environments.
Experience partnering with architects, facilities teams, project managers, construction teams, and external vendors.
Strong understanding of national and local building code considerations relevant to security design.
Ability to balance security requirements, operational needs, user experience, and aesthetic considerations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and provide clear design guidance.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

Technical Skills

Proficiency in CAD
Proficiency in Revit

Preferred Characteristics

Strategic thinker with strong attention to detail
Ability to operate effectively in a complex, global environment
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
Collaborative and partnership-oriented approach
Ability to assess emerging risks and translate them into practical design standards

Primary Interfaces

Global Security
Facilities
Construction Project Management
Corporate Real Estate
Architects, engineers, and design consultants
External vendors and integrators
Audit and risk stakeholders, as needed

Role Purpose

This role is critical to ensuring that BNY’s global physical environments are designed to support safety, security, resilience, and operational effectiveness while maintaining consistency with enterprise standards and design expectations.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

BNY assesses market data to ensure a competitive compensation package for our employees. The expected base salary for this position when employment commences can be found in the Job Info section at the bottom of the posting.

Base salary offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Base salary is only part of the total rewards package, which may include eligibility for an annual discretionary incentive award. Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, eligible employees may enroll in a 401(k) plan as well as participate in Company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance plans for the employee and the employee’s eligible dependents. Eligible employees also may receive other benefits (including various paid time off benefits, such as vacation and sick time), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, the employee will be in an “at will” position and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payments or compensation programs) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

added.title: Sr Director, Cyber Solutions & Engineering
added.description:
Mythics and Emergent are evolving from a transactional VAR into a platform-led cybersecurity advisory business. The Senior Director, Cyber Solutions & Engineering will lead the technical architecture and engineering strategy behind the organization's cybersecurity assessment offerings, agentic AI platform, and delivery capabilities across State and Local Government, Higher Education, Federal, Defense, and Commercial markets.

This leader will establish and scale the Cyber Engineering function, create reference architectures, define engineering standards, and transform advisory methodologies into repeatable, productized platform capabilities that drive recurring revenue. The role partners closely with sales enablement, consulting, delivery, and OEM alliance teams to align technical execution with strategic growth objectives.

Duties and Responsibilities

Assessment Engineering

Translate advisory assessment methodologies, including Identity Threat Discovery, Active Exploit Exposure, Shadow AI & Non-Human Identity, and Cyber Baseline, into repeatable, tooling-enabled delivery capabilities.
Build the engineering foundation that converts fixed-fee assessments into recurring, subscription-based platform revenue.
Architect telemetry normalization, analytics, and reporting capabilities that clearly communicate client risk and security posture.

Platform & Architecture Leadership

Own the technical architecture for the organization's agentic AI security platform, including multi-agent orchestration, data pipelines, and cloud-native deployment across Azure and AWS.
Define enterprise reference architectures, engineering guardrails, deployment standards, and platform design principles.
Advance platform capabilities and roadmap initiatives that support compliance readiness for public sector and regulated market customers.

Governance & Executive Engagement

Establish AI governance practices, including acceptable use standards, data classification, data loss prevention (DLP), and shadow AI controls.
Deliver executive-level technical, risk, and security posture briefings to leadership and client stakeholders.
Partner with OEM alliances to integrate best-of-breed solutions across identity, deception, non-human identity, and adjacent cybersecurity domains.

Team & Function Building

Establish and scale the Cyber Engineering function, including operating models, team charters, hiring plans, and delivery frameworks.
Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing engineering organization.
Implement modern delivery practices and operational disciplines, including Kanban-based workflows and executive reporting mechanisms.
Modernize legacy approaches and introduce innovative methodologies, technologies, and strategic partnerships to address evolving cyber threats.

Other Duties

Perform all other duties, as assigned.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
12+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise security programs with progressive leadership responsibility.
Demonstrated success establishing security functions from the ground up, including operating models, governance structures, and multi-year strategic roadmaps.
Deep expertise in cloud security architectures across Azure and AWS environments.
Experience designing and implementing Zero Trust architectures, SIEM/SOAR platforms, DevSecOps practices, and infrastructure-as-code solutions.
Experience with security data engineering, including telemetry normalization frameworks such as OCSF, data lakes, and AI/ML-driven analytics.
Experience leading portfolio rationalization and cybersecurity cost optimization initiatives.
Ability to communicate complex security risks and investment priorities to executive and board-level audiences.
Familiarity with compliance and regulatory frameworks including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and FedRAMP.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in consulting, cybersecurity advisory services, value-added reseller (VAR) organizations, or platform-based technology businesses.
Experience supporting State and Local Government, Higher Education, Federal, Defense, and Commercial sectors.
Exposure to agentic AI, non-human identity, and shadow AI security domains.
CISSP or equivalent advanced cybersecurity certification.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities (KSAs)

Enterprise cybersecurity strategy and architecture expertise.
Cloud security architecture across Azure and AWS.
Zero Trust security principles and implementation methodologies.
Security operations, SIEM, SOAR, and threat detection capabilities.
Security data engineering and telemetry normalization frameworks.
AI governance, risk management, and emerging AI security practices.
DevSecOps methodologies and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Python, CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, and automation technologies.
Executive communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.
Cybersecurity assessment development and service productization.
Strategic planning, organizational design, and function-building capabilities.
Team leadership, coaching, and talent development.
Vendor, alliance, and partner management expertise.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
Ability to translate technical security concepts into business outcomes and investment strategies.

Senior Manager of Software Development

The Senior Manager of Software Development is a hands-on technical and people leader responsible for the architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise-level software products in a regulated medical device environment. This role leads and mentors multiple software engineering teams, drives large and concurrent development programs, and partners across Product Management, Systems Engineering, Verification, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and other functions to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
The ideal candidate combines strategic technology leadership with active participation in software design, coding, code reviews, troubleshooting, risk management, and lifecycle execution. This leader will build engineering capability, guide pragmatic architecture decisions, and drive disciplined delivery across complex programs.
Key Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership, architectural direction, and a clear engineering vision for complex software products, platforms, and large development programs.
Remain actively involved in software architecture, system design, technology selection, coding, design reviews, code reviews, debugging, performance optimization, and critical technical problem-solving.
Design pragmatic architectures that prioritize maintainability, extensibility, cybersecurity, reliability, scalability, and business value while avoiding unnecessary complexity and over-engineering.
Drive the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, feasibility estimates, planning, design, coding, documentation, testing, implementation, release, patching, configuration changes, and defect support.
Manage multiple concurrent projects, including project plans, resource planning, schedules, development timelines, budgets, scope, quality, risk, and delivery commitments.

Maintain, enhance, and modernize legacy software systems while balancing technical debt, product requirements, cybersecurity needs, and long-term architectural goals.
