added.description:
X-energy LLC conducts a thorough recruiting process and will never issue offers without interview to discuss qualifications and responsibilities. All applications will be submitted via our company career page, www.x-energy.com/careers/. We will never ask you to provide payment information as part of the recruiting process. If anyone claiming to represent X-energy directs you in a manner otherwise, please contact us at www.x-energy.com/contact-us.

Job Description

The Director, Value Engineering and Product Management at X-energy will work cross functionally across Project Controls, Engineering, Procurement / Supply Chain, Construction, Operations and Project Finance/Commercial Development. This role will help to inform engineering design and technical decision-making in real-time by providing relevant cost and value data and implications, enabling the organization to make smart design choices based on trade-offs between cost and value / efficiency and between CAPEX and OPEX to optimize the whole-life value of Xe products and projects.

A major part of this role is to work with Engineering to identify and constructively challenge:

• Over-engineering
• Excessive conservatism
• Redundant scope
• Complex interfaces
• Low-value requirements

This role will be the ‘voice of the customer’ within our projects—enabling engineering teams to make design decisions with short and long-term cost and schedule implications fully in mind. They will build the connective tissue between disparate parts of the organization. They will sit alongside engineers, understand design challenges, and then turn around and deliver fast, usable cost estimates that help them make trade-off decisions. They will build both the framework and the habit: the tools that make rapid cost / value estimates possible, and the culture that incentivizes the engineering teams to use them.

This work will directly influence which design paths X-energy pursues and how it successfully delivers its first-of-a-kind and nth-of-a-kind megaprojects.

This role requires deep megaproject cost estimating experience, strong organizational savvy, ability to communicate effectively at all levels in the organization, and the confidence to build something from scratch. When people tell you something isn't possible, you find a way.
This position serves as the executive voice of the customer within projects by translating technical decisions into short- and long-term cost and schedule implications and ensuring those trade-offs are visible, understood, and acted upon at the point of decision. The role builds and institutionalizes the connective structure between disparate parts of the organization by establishing the strategy, tools, processes, governance, and working relationships that allow engineering teams to access fast, usable cost and value estimates in real time.

The Director, Value Engineering and Product Management also plays a key role in setting the enterprise approach to identifying and constructively challenging over-engineering, excessive conservatism, redundant scope, complex interfaces, and low-value requirements. This work directly influences design path decisions, portfolio outcomes, and the successful delivery of first-of-a-kind and nth-of-a-kind megaprojects.

Job Profile Tasks/Responsibilities:

Connect finance, commercial development, and engineering organizations around a shared understanding of project costs, value drivers, and trade-off implications.
This role leads the development and implementation of cost control systems, plans, and procedures across project portfolios, building and leading a rapid cost estimating framework that enables engineering to evaluate design trade-offs in real time—creating the framework, tools, processes, and culture needed to make it a reality.
Monitor budgets, expenditures, and forecasts to ensure compliance with all project and corporate financial objectives; identify cost variances, potential risks, and savings opportunities, proposing corrective actions as required; prepare and maintain detailed cost reports, dashboards, and forecasts for project leadership and stakeholders; conduct variance analysis, cash flow tracking, and earned value performance reporting.
Serve as the ‘voice of the customer’ within project teams, translating technical decisions into cost and schedule impacts, CAPEX vs OPEX considerations, and construction and maintenance impacts, and ensuring that cost / value implications are visible and understood at the point of decision.
Embed oneself in the engineering organization— work across project management, engineering, procurement, and finance teams to build relationships, understand design challenges, and create trust so that teams reach for cost / value estimating as a tool as opposed to a burden.
Champion a culture of cost-conscious engineering—build the muscle within Project Controls to produce fast, usable estimates and help teams understand that cost estimating is not a constraint but an enabler of smart, faster decision-making.

Job Profile Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, finance, or other. A wide range of educational backgrounds could fit, from engineering to business, and the priority will be the right combination of work experiences that prepares for this unique role. We need someone with quantitative / financial fluency and also deep comfort with highly technical issues, not at all intimidated to stand their ground in front of a room of engineers.
10-15+ years experience in cost estimating, project controls, or value engineering, with deep experience in megaprojects (ideally $500M+ capital projects in energy, infrastructure, construction, or industrial sectors).
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, earned value management (EVM), and financial reporting. Proficiency in SAP, Oracle, or equivalent ERP systems and expert use of Microsoft Excel. Proven ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and communicate financial implications. Strategic thinker with excellent leadership, collaboration, and communication capabilities.
The successful candidate will be an entrepreneurial self-starter with ability to think about the next horizon of what is possible and eager to drive an organization to make it happen.

added.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and Delivery
added.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery
: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What You’ll Do

Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.
Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.
Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.
Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.
Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.
Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.
Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.
Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.
Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.
Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.
Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.
Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.
Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.
Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.
Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.
Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.
Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.
Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.
People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.
Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $200,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. added.description:
About Rad AI

At Rad AI, we’re on a mission to transform healthcare with artificial intelligence. Founded by a radiologist, our AI-driven solutions are revolutionizing radiology—saving time, reducing burnout, and improving patient care. With one of the largest proprietary radiology report datasets in the world, our AI has helped uncover hundreds of new cancer diagnoses and reduced error rates in tens of millions of radiology reports by nearly 50%.

Rad AI has secured over $140M in funding, including a recently oversubscribed Series C ($68M round) led by Transformation Capital, bringing our valuation to $528M. Our investors include Khosla Ventures, World Innovation Lab, Gradient Ventures, Cone Health Ventures, and others—all backing our mission to empower physicians with cutting-edge AI.

Our latest advancements in generative AI are used by thousands of radiologists daily, supporting more than one-third of radiology groups and healthcare systems and nearly 50% of all medical imaging in the U.S. at partners including Cone Health, Jefferson Einstein Health, Geisinger, Guthrie Healthcare System, and Henry Ford Health.

Recognized as one of the most promising healthcare AI companies by CB Insights and AuntMinnie , and ranked by Deloitte as the 19th fastest-growing company in North America, we are building AI-powered solutions that make a real impact. Most recently, Rad AI was named to CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list, highlighting the innovation and momentum behind our mission.

If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to have you on our team!

Why We Need You

The products we build are used every day by radiologists making critical decisions with diagnoses that determine what care patients receive next. That’s not a context where “good enough” ships.

We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who can hold that standard while also scaling a team that keeps pace with Rad AI’s growth. Someone who has lived through the full lifecycle of production software from the architectural decision that aged well to the one that didn’t and who brings that hard-won judgment to every conversation with their engineers.

This isn’t a coordination role. You’ll shape technical direction, develop the engineers around you, and drive outcomes on one of our core products. The team you build here will define how clinicians experience AI for years to come.

Here’s What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll lead one of our core product engineering teams where you’ll:
Own end-to-end execution on your team’s roadmap from planning, prioritization, delivery, rollout, and iteration across one or more core products.
Raise the technical bar by guiding architecture and design decisions, ensuring your team builds observable, maintainable systems that meet healthcare-grade reliability standards.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Implementations, Design, Clinical, Customer Success, and GTM counterparts to translate customer problems into clear, actionable engineering work.
Drive continuous improvement across planning, estimation, code review, incident response, on-call, and documentation while evolving team processes and pushing the limits of AI to unlock new levels of efficiency and quality.
Use data and metrics to drive decisions, defining and tracking the right leading indicators for reliability, performance, and delivery health.
Hire exceptional engineers, develop the talent already on your team, and foster a culture of psychological safety, ownership, and continuous learning.

Who We’re Looking For

6–8+ years of experience managing software engineers with a proven track record leading teams that ship and operate production software at scale.
A strong engineering foundation where you started as a hands-on engineer and are still comfortable going deep in technical discussions even if you’re no longer the primary coder.
Experience leading teams building production web or cloud applications in modern stacks (e.g., Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, distributed systems on a major cloud provider).
Excellent execution and stakeholder management: you set clear priorities, navigate tradeoffs, and keep teams aligned when requirements evolve.
Strong communication across technical and non-technical audiences with a track record of influencing across functions without formal authority.
A pragmatic, outcomes-oriented mindset where you’ve balanced ideal architecture with real-world constraints and have bias toward incremental, value-driven delivery.
Genuine enjoyment of building and scaling healthy engineering teams: hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.

It Would Be Nice If

You’ve worked in healthtech, healthcare data, or a regulated environment (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2) and understand what that demands from a software team.
You’re familiar with radiology workflows or adjacent clinical systems (PACS, RIS, EHR, HL7/FHIR, DICOM).
You’ve led teams that work closely with ML/AI systems in production and understand what’s different about those operational challenges.
You’ve managed multiple teams or a small org, including partnering with Staff or Principal engineers to set technical direction.

Join our world-class team as we build and deploy AI solutions that empower physicians and transform patient care—making a meaningful impact on millions of lives. Driven by our mission, we prioritize transparency, inclusion, and close collaboration, bringing together exceptional people to revolutionize healthcare. If you're passionate about driving innovation and delivering impactful healthcare solutions, we'd love to hear from you!

To learn more about what it's like to work at Rad AI, visit https://www.radai.com/life-at-rad-ai and be sure to follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date!

JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer
to lead the architecture and delivery of production-grade AI systems built on agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM orchestration. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for a team of engineers building autonomous AI pipelines that extract, validate, and reason over complex unstructured documents. You will own the technical vision for a multi-agent ecosystem -- designing pipeline orchestration engines, embedding/vectorization strategies, knowledge retrieval systems, and AI-assisted code generation tooling. You will lead a VP-level engineer and a broader team of 4-8 developers. This role is in New York, NY

What Sets This Role Apart
- You build the agent framework, not just configure one -- custom orchestration engine, not a LangChain wrapper - Production AI with real consequences -- extraction accuracy directly impacts financial operations - Full RAG ownership -- from raw OCR bytes through embedding, retrieval, and generation - Evaluation-driven culture -- golden-truth datasets, automated regression, measurable quality gates - Greenfield AI + enterprise integration -- build new AI-native systems that plug into established platforms

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to impact on our organization in the following ways:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, and autonomous decision chains - Design and evolve RAG infrastructure -- chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, vector store selection, retrieval ranking, and context window optimization - Define vectorization strategy: embedding model selection, dimensionality trade-offs, hybrid search (dense + sparse), and re-ranking approaches - Own the AI pipeline orchestration framework -- blocks, inlets/outlets, blackboards, memory stores, and content policy enforcement - Make build-vs-buy decisions across the AI toolchain (vector databases, agent frameworks, evaluation harnesses, model gateways) - Establish patterns for prompt engineering at scale: prompt versioning, chain-of-thought decomposition, few-shot management, and guardrails

Agentic & RAG Systems

Design multi-agent architectures with shared memory, blackboard patterns, and inter-agent communication protocols - Build autonomous extraction agents capable of planning, tool selection, self-correction, and validation - Implement knowledge graph construction from unstructured documents -- entity extraction, relationship mapping, and graph-based retrieval - Develop evaluation frameworks: retrieval precision/recall, extraction accuracy, agent task completion rates, and hallucination detection - Design feedback loops: human-in-the-loop correction, reinforcement from golden-truth datasets, and continuous prompt refinement

Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 4-8 engineers (AI/ML, backend, full-stack) - Directly manage a VP-level AI engineer; provide technical guidance and career development - Drive architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical decision-making - Own sprint planning, technical backlog, and delivery commitments - Foster a culture of rapid experimentation balanced with production rigor

Hands-On Engineering -

Implement core agentic components: agent loops, tool registries, memory persistence, and reasoning traces - Build embedding pipelines -- document preprocessing, chunk boundary detection, metadata enrichment, and vector index management - Develop scoring and validation systems (Bayesian confidence, cross-agent consensus, golden-truth comparison) - Contribute to platform services (Java/Spring Boot) and AI service layer (Python/FastAPI) - Build AI-assisted developer tooling: code generation workflows, automated test generation, and intelligent code review

Delivery & Operations

Own CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and environment promotion - Define observability: agent execution traces, token usage tracking, retrieval quality metrics, and pipeline telemetry - Manage schema evolution and data stores (relational + vector) - Coordinate cross-team dependencies with platform engineering, data engineering, and infrastructure

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelor's degree or Advanced degree in computer science engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. 10+ years of professional software engineering experience - 3+ years leading or technically mentoring engineering teams - Deep expertise in AI/ML systems: - LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, chain-of-thought reasoning - RAG architectures: chunking, embedding, retrieval, re-ranking, context assembly - Agentic patterns: ReAct, tool-use, planning loops, multi-agent coordination - Vector databases and embedding models (OpenAI embeddings, sentence-transformers, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar) - Strong Python (3.11+): FastAPI, async/await, Poetry, Pydantic, pytest - Solid Java experience: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, microservice architecture - Production AI delivery: not just prototypes -- systems handling real workloads with observability, error recovery, and audit trails - Document intelligence: OCR pipelines, NLP, structured extraction from unstructured text - Testing & evaluation: golden-truth validation, retrieval metrics (MRR, NDCG), extraction F1 scores, agent success rates - Enterprise architecture: API design, circuit breakers, caching, event-driven patterns

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building custom agent frameworks (not just using LangChain/CrewAI out-of-the-box) - Knowledge of graph-based retrieval -- knowledge graphs, graph RAG, entity-relationship extraction - Experience with code AI: AI-assisted development tools, code generation pipelines, automated refactoring - Familiarity with model fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, or RLHF techniques - Exposure to evaluation-driven development -- automated prompt regression testing, A/B testing of retrieval strategies - Angular/TypeScript experience for full-stack visibility - Capital markets or financial services domain knowledge - Familiarity with enterprise AI governance: content policies, PII handling, data residency

Technology Stack

AI/Agentic-
LLM orchestration, multi-agent systems, ReAct patterns, tool-use, autonomous pipelines

RAG & Vectors-
Embedding models, vector stores, hybrid search, re-ranking, chunk optimization

LLM-
Azure OpenAI, GPT-4o, enterprise model gateways, prompt versioning

Python-
Python 3.12/3.13, FastAPI, Poetry, Pydantic, async pipelines

Java-
Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, Maven, Resilience4j, Hazelcast

Frontend-
Angular 19, TypeScript, D3.js, ECharts

Oracle, PostgreSQL, vector databases

Infrastructure-
Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Artifactory

Agent traces, token tracking, retrieval quality metrics, audit pipelines

The Technology Delivery Lead Developer role is a hands-on role focused on designing, developing, and maintaining application development frameworks which help integrate vendor and proprietary solutions that support scalable, secure, reusable solutions across the Compliance, Surveillance and Supervision area. Responsibilities include planning, designing, and developing common development components which will be used across delivery workstreams. added.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
added.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Senior Manager, Data Engineering, leads teams in designing, building, and overseeing the deployment and operation of technology architecture, solutions, and software to capture, manage, store, and utilize structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources. This role is responsible for establishing processes, automations, and big data systems based on business and technical requirements, ensuring data quality, troubleshooting user issues in large distributed systems, and creating machine learning pipelines. The Senior Manager acts as a leader for engineering teams, removing blockers, enabling productivity, and fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture. The role also involves coaching and developing engineers to adapt to evolving tools, frameworks, and AI-driven workflows, and partnering closely with product managers, QA, risk, compliance, and security functions to deliver safe, transparent, and customer-centric solutions.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities

Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentoring to a team of 8-10 engineers, delivering robust, scalable solutions on time
Serve as technical lead for some of the products in the organization — driving planning, architecture, hands-on development, and technical direction
Own customer engagement for assigned products: manage customer expectations, drive adoption, and act as the primary technical point of contact
Lead the design and implementation of secure, reliable, and performant systems that meet the platform's functional needs
Build and promote an agile, high-quality engineering culture across design, development, and production deployment
Partner with geographically distributed teams to resolve technical challenges and improve processes
Drive knowledge sharing with Operations teams during and after deployment
Champion innovation by evaluating and adopting technologies and practices — including GenAI — that improve productivity and quality

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

8+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience.
3+ years of relevant work experience managing engineering teams
5+ years of experience with Big Data technologies (Hive, Hadoop, Spark)
5+ years of experience with Java, Scala, or Python; able to write clean, production-quality prototypes and core components quickly

Preferred Qualifications

9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
Experience with Graph databases and RESTful APIs
Hands-on experience applying GenAI and LLMs in data engineering, including leading initiatives that use GenAI to improve team efficiency
Proven track record leading large-scale projects with quantifiable business outcomes, from inception to delivery
Strong leadership and team-building skills, including mentoring and growing junior engineers
Skilled at setting technical goals with measurable success metrics, including evaluating services from a user-experience perspective
Results-oriented and self-motivated, with a strong learning mindset and current knowledge of data-domain trends, technologies, and best practices
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate architectural concepts clearly across all levels of the organization, including executive management
Experience with cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) for data engineering solutions.
Experience with machine learning and AI-powered data solutions.
Experience in developing large-scale, enterprise-class distributed systems of high availability and low latency.
Experience in leading cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.

added.title: Senior Manager, Reliability Engineering
added.description:
Who We Are

More efficient. More accurate. More accessible. Exol is bringing industry-leading automation to businesses of all sizes through an innovative warehouse-as-a-service model.

What We Need

Exol is seeking a Senior Manager, Reliability Engineering
who will be responsible for establishing and scaling a reliability-driven maintenance and asset performance program across Exol’s highly automated warehouse operations. This role ensures that equipment, automation, and infrastructure are designed, maintained, and operated to deliver predictable uptime, safety, and cost control especially during startup, ramp-up, and network expansion.

This role operates centrally, with direct influence across sites, and serves as the enterprise owner of reliability strategy.

What We Do

Exol is pioneering warehousing-as-a-service, offering outsourced warehousing operations, and specializing in automated warehousing solutions. Our focus is on the efficient movement of goods in cases and pallets across all sectors, such as wholesale, retail, and general merchandising.   

Exol is an independently managed joint venture between Symbotic and Softbank.

What You’ll Do

Own and scale the reliability strategy for automated fulfillment and material handling operations.
Establish enterprise reliability standards and performance expectations across sites.
Identify critical assets and failure risks impacting throughput, safety, and cost, lead root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
Design risk-based maintenance approaches aligned to business impact and asset criticality.
Partner with Automation and Engineering teams to influence system design for long term reliability.
Define reliability data standards, KPIs, and reporting within CMMS and related systems.
Analyze downtime, performance trends, and cost drivers to support staffing, capital, and vendor decisions.
Support new site launches by ensuring reliability readiness, documentation, and clean handoff to operations.
Standardize learnings to enable repeatable, predictable site deployments at scale.
Lead OEM and vendor partnerships, including performance governance and escalation management.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, IT, Safety, Finance, and Supply Chain to align reliability priorities.
Communicate risks, trends, and improvement opportunities clearly to senior leadership.

What We Need

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Reliability, or related field) or equivalent experience required.
Minimum 12 years of experience in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering, or asset performance roles.
Experience supporting automated or highly mechanized environments such as robotics, AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, or automated material handling systems.
Proven experience influencing multi-site operations or enterprise programs preferred.
Startup, ramp up, or greenfield launch experience strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of reliability principles, asset lifecycle management, and failure analysis.
Demonstrated ability to translate technical issues into business risk and financial impact.
Experience working with CMMS platforms and performance reporting tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to lead through influence rather than direct authority.
Clear, concise communication skills suitable for executive audiences.

Physical & Environment Requirements

Ability to work in active warehouse and automation environments, including multi-level structures and elevated platforms.
Must be able to comply with all safety requirements, including PPE, LOTO, and fall protection standards.
Extended onsite presence may be required during critical launches or stabilization periods.

Our Environment

Up to 60% travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.
The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.

About Exol

Exol provides flexible and scalable outsourced warehouse services to meet the dynamic needs of the modern supply chain. We operate state-of-the-art distribution centers, allowing you to focus on your business while we handle the complexities of warehouse operations. For more information, visit www.exol.com.

This role will lead the data engineering function supporting People Analytics, including AI-assisted workforce analytics on Snowflake. This is a player-coach role requiring hands-on technical leadership plus people leadership, with strong business partnership and the ability to balance speed, quality, governance, and innovation.

What you’ll do:

Manage and develop data engineers

Manage, coach, and grow a team of data engineers.
Set expectations for quality, collaboration, delivery, and technical ownership.
Create a strong engineering culture where people solve hard problems, move quickly, and enjoy the work.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as other data engineers, people analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders, to translate requirements into production-ready deliverables, and communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.

Write and review production code.
Lead design reviews, code reviews, and technical problem solving.
Step into critical pipelines, models, or AI workflows when needed.

Build scalable People data foundations

Design and maintain sustainable data models, pipelines, semantic layers, and testing frameworks.
Establish team practices for documentation, lineage, data quality, and observability.

Own engineering standards

Set standards for SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow, Snowflake, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release management.
Ensure the team ships work that is reliable, maintainable, secure, and understandable.
Enforce data governance policies and practices to maintain data integrity, security, and compliance with relevant regulations.

Support AI enabled analytics

Own technical delivery for AI-assisted workforce analytics and internal tools.
Translate business needs into scalable technical designs, delivery plans, and engineering milestones.
Partner with People Analytics, People leaders, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to deliver trusted workforce insights.
Partner on semantic models, evaluation datasets, testing, and quality controls for AI-assisted analytics

Balance speed and rigor

Create enough process to protect quality, privacy, and trust for sensitive People data without slowing the team unnecessarily.

What you’ll need:

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform engineering.
5+ years managing or formally leading engineers.
Proficiency in data engineering tech stack: Python / SQL / dbt / Airflow / Gitlab .
Experience designing dimensional models, semantic layers, data marts, or analytical data products.
Experience with data quality, testing, lineage, observability, and production support.
Strong ability to translate business needs into technical architecture.
Experience with sensitive or regulated data and access controls.
Proven ability to coach engineers and build healthy technical culture
Strong communication with technical and non technical stakeholders
Proficiency in relational and cloud database platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, or GCP.
Thorough knowledge of data modeling, database design, data architecture principles, data operations, and CI/CD.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to simplify complex issues into actionable plans.

Preferred Experience

People analytics, HR data, compensation, talent, workforce planning, or Workday experience
Experience building AI, LLM, RAG, or natural language analytics products
Experience with Snowflake Cortex AI, Streamlit, semantic models, or evaluation frameworks
Experience in fintech, banking, or regulated environments

added.title: Head of Gov Compute Delivery, EC2 Gov
added.description:
Description

Application deadline: Oct 11, 2026

Frontier AI is moving faster than infrastructure has ever had to keep up with. We're hiring the Head of Gov Compute Delivery, a Senior Manager, to lead a team of Technical Program Managers to deliver billions of dollars of server and GPU capacity — staying ahead of customer demand, frontier model needs, and the next wave of AI.

You'll own the team at the heart of how AWS scales for AI, keeping capacity ahead of an unprecedented demand curve, partnering across software, hardware, supply chain, networking, datacenter engineering, power, compliance, and finance teams. Your team will own near-term and long-term compute delivery at multi-gigawatt scale for Government regions, including critical decision making with highly visible leadership reporting.

From day one, you'll have ownership and autonomy to set strategy and build the team that delivers it, making data-driven decisions on programs that influence leadership at the highest levels. Your team will have a front-row seat to emerging AI trends, and you'll have a real say in how AWS shows up for the most demanding workloads on earth.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

Own, through your team, EC2 capacity delivery against global commitments to AWS's largest Government customers and frontier-AI workloads.

Produce executive-visible reporting that drives capacity, capital, and engineering-investment decisions.

Set strategy and program structure where none exists, and drive cross-functional alignment at scale.

Influence priorities across a diverse set of stakeholders and partners — up to VP level.

Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond.

What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet.

Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies.

Position Summary

Flagship Pioneering is building a dedicated Legal Operations & Technology function, and we are hiring a second Legal Technology and AI Specialist to help lead its hands-on build-out of AI-powered tools and workflows across the legal department. Reporting to the Director, Legal Operations & Technology, this role combines technical AI engineering skills with legal domain knowledge to design, implement, and maintain AI solutions that accelerate legal service delivery across the organization.

Legal Operations & Technology is the engine that makes the legal function run efficiently — owning the department's technology stack, process design, vendor relationships, and performance metrics. As a foundational member of this new team, you will translate that operational mandate into working technology, partnering closely with attorneys, the broader legal team, and stakeholders across Flagship.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency in AI/ML systems and a working understanding of legal operations gained through direct exposure to in-house legal work. This is a ground-floor opportunity to shape how a leading life sciences and venture creation organization integrates AI into its legal function from day one.

Key Responsibilities

AI Development and Implementation

Build, configure, and deploy AI-powered tools and workflows for the legal team, including solutions for contract review, legal research, document drafting, compliance monitoring, and knowledge management.
Develop, test, and maintain prompt libraries and prompt engineering frameworks for generative AI systems used across the legal department.
Design and implement integrations between AI tools and the Legal Operations &Technology stack (CLM, document management, matter management, e-billing).
Prototype and iterate on AI-assisted workflows, moving from proof-of-concept to production deployment.
Monitor emerging AI capabilities (including agentic AI workflows) and evaluate their applicability to Flagship's legal operations.

AI Governance and Quality Control

Support the development and maintenance of internal AI usage policies and acceptable-use standards for the legal department.
Build quality control procedures for AI-generated legal work product, including validation protocols, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and output review standards.
Conduct technical risk assessments on new AI tools, evaluating for data security, confidentiality, bias, and hallucination risk before deployment.
Partner with Flagship's IT, information security, and data privacy teams to ensure legal AI tools comply with organizational security standards.

Process, Training, and Adoption

Serve as a go-to AI resource for the legal team: design and deliver training sessions on effective use of AI tools, responsible prompting, and output verification.
Document and standardize AI-assisted workflows, creating playbooks and best-practice guides that fit within the broader Legal Operations & Technology process framework.
Track adoption metrics, define KPIs, and measure the ROI of AI initiatives across the legal team, reporting results to Legal Operations leadership.

Vendor and Tool Evaluation

Support Legal Operations & Technology vendor evaluations, product demonstrations, and pilot programs for legal AI platforms and adjacent legal technology.
Provide technical assessment of vendor AI capabilities, architecture, and data handling practices.
Recommend tools and platforms based on technical merit, integration feasibility, total cost of ownership, and alignment with the legal team's needs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with business and technology stakeholders across Flagship to identify opportunities where legal AI capabilities can support broader organizational objectives.
Contribute to enterprise-wide AI governance initiatives as the Legal Operations & Technology team's technical representative.
Collaborate with attorneys and legal operations colleagues to translate legal workflow needs into technical requirements.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in computer science, AI/ML, data science, engineering, or a related technical field.
Demonstrated experience building or engineering AI/ML solutions, including working with large language models, natural language processing, or related technologies.
Practical understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning, and AI system evaluation.
Exposure to legal operations, legal workflows, or the legal industry through internship, work experience, or coursework.
Familiarity with the legal technology landscape (CLM platforms, AI-assisted research tools, document automation, e-discovery).
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical AI concepts for legal and business audiences.
Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize in a fast-paced, build-from-scratch environment.

Preferred

Prior internship or work experience in an in-house legal department, law firm, or legal operations team.
Experience with legal-specific AI tools (contract AI, legal research platforms, document review systems).
Familiarity with responsible AI use policies, digital and data governance, data privacy frameworks (GDPR, state privacy laws) as they relate to AI deployment.
Background in or exposure to life sciences, biotech, or venture capital.
Experience developing AI governance frameworks, usage policies, or responsible AI guidelines.
Coursework or certifications in legal studies, legal technology, or legal operations.

Why This Role

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of AI engineering and legal operations at a leading life sciences and venture creation organization. As a member of Flagship's Legal Operations & Technology team, you will have direct ownership of how the legal function leverages AI, with visibility across the full portfolio and the autonomy to build solutions from the ground up. For someone with both technical AI depth and an interest in the legal domain, this role offers an accelerated path to becoming a leader in the rapidly growing legal AI and legal operations space.

Standard office environment in Cambridge with hybrid flexibility options.
Collaborative, interdisciplinary teams engaged in high-impact innovation.
Professional growth opportunities across Flagship Pioneering and its portfolio.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.

added.title: Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer
added.description:
Forequence is seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial technical leader to join as Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer. This is a founder partnership with meaningful ownership, not a conventional salaried executive role or outsourced development position.

The Opportunity

Unlike many early-stage opportunities, you will not be starting with only an idea. Forequence already has:

A clearly defined enterprise problem
A developed product vision
Proprietary indices, scoring methodologies, and assessment logic
A growing body of original global research
An early MVP
Ongoing enterprise pilot conversations
Leading research, strategy, positioning, commercial development, and go-to-market
The foundation for a differentiated and defensible category in organizational intelligence

About Forequence

Forequence is an enterprise intelligence platform that helps organizations detect human strain before it becomes burnout, attrition, disengagement, or execution failure. Organizations have become highly sophisticated at measuring productivity, performance, revenue, and output. They remain far less capable of understanding the human capacity sustaining those outcomes. Most workforce platforms tell companies what has already happened. Forequence is being built to help organizations see what is developing beneath the surface, understand where human capacity is under pressure, identify the conditions driving that pressure, and intervene before it becomes an expensive organizational failure. Through proprietary organizational indices, behavioral signals, AI-supported analysis, and enterprise intelligence, Forequence helps leaders make better decisions about people, performance, capacity, and risk.

Meaningful Founder Ownership

You will join as a genuine co-founder with meaningful equity and long-term participation in the value you help create. This is not an advisory title, symbolic ownership, or an employee role disguised as a founder opportunity. The right person will help shape the company's technology, product, strategy, team, fundraising, and future. Equity, vesting, responsibilities, decision rights, intellectual property, and founder expectations will be discussed transparently and formalized properly.

Build From a Stronger Starting Point

You will not be responsible for inventing the problem, researching the market from scratch, creating the brand, defining the initial methodology, and building the technology alone. Forequence already has a substantial body of developed intellectual property, research, scoring logic, product thinking, market positioning, and commercial direction. You will bring the technical depth required to transform those assets into a scalable enterprise platform.

Significant Product Influence

The platform is early enough for you to make foundational decisions. You will have meaningful authority over:

Product architecture
Technical strategy
AI and data infrastructure
Enterprise security and privacy
Engineering standards
Product development priorities
Technical hiring
Platform integrations
Scalability and defensibility
The long-term technology roadmap

A Timely Market Opportunity

Artificial intelligence is accelerating the speed, complexity, and intensity of work. As organizations invest more heavily in automation, productivity, and performance technologies, they will also need better intelligence about the people operating alongside those systems. The central question is no longer only whether companies can increase output. It is whether they can understand the human capacity required to sustain that output. Forequence is positioned at the intersection of enterprise AI, workforce intelligence, organizational performance, people analytics, and human sustainability.

Build the Team and Culture From the Beginning

You will have the opportunity to recruit the early engineering and data team, establish the technical culture, and define how the company builds. You will not inherit a dysfunctional engineering organization, outdated infrastructure, or a deeply embedded development process. The early technical standards will be yours to help create.

The Partnership

As Co-Founder And CTO, You Will Work Directly With The Founder To Build Forequence Into a Scalable Enterprise Company. The Partnership Will Include

Meaningful co-founder equity
Shared responsibility for company direction
Direct influence over major product and business decisions
A clear division of ownership based on complementary strengths
Transparent founder agreements and vesting
Participation in fundraising and investor conversations
The opportunity to build and lead the technical organization
Long-term involvement in the commercial value created by the platform

What You Will Own

Technology — Define the architecture, engineering roadmap, infrastructure, development standards, and technical direction of Forequence.
Product Development — Translate proprietary research, indices, assessment logic, and enterprise requirements into a functional, intuitive, and commercially viable platform.
AI and Data — Develop the systems required to identify patterns, surface insights, support organizational decision-making, and responsibly incorporate AI into the product.
Security Readiness — Establish the security, privacy, governance, reliability, and technical controls required to serve enterprise customers.
Validation — Work directly with prospective customers and pilot organizations to refine use cases, test assumptions, prioritize development, and improve the product.
Technical Team — Recruit, lead, and develop the early engineering, data, and technical product team.
Strategy — Contribute to product positioning, pricing, commercial strategy, partnerships, fundraising, and the long-term development of the company.
Capital — Participate in technical due diligence, investor conversations, fundraising strategy, and the articulation of Forequence's technological advantage.

Co-Founder Profile

About

You do not need to meet every requirement. We care more about depth, judgment, learning ability, founder mentality, and alignment than a perfect résumé. You may be a strong fit if you have:

Experience building and shipping complex software products
Worked as a technical founder, CTO, senior engineer, architect, or engineering leader
Strong hands-on technical capability
Experience building B2B SaaS, AI, analytics, data, HR technology, or enterprise platforms
A solid understanding of modern cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases, application architecture, and security
The ability to translate ambiguous problems into practical technical systems
Strong product judgment
Experience working directly with customers or enterprise stakeholders
The ability to recruit and lead technical talent
An understanding of startup constraints and disciplined prioritization
High standards, intellectual honesty, and low ego
The willingness to make a serious long-term commitment to building Forequence

Particularly Relevant Experience

Experience In Any Of The Following Would Be Valuable

Enterprise SaaS
Applied AI or machine learning
Data analytics platforms
People analytics
HR technology
Workforce intelligence
Organizational network analysis
Predictive or risk intelligence
Data visualization
Privacy-sensitive technology
SOC 2 readiness
GDPR or PIPEDA compliance
Enterprise integrations
Early-stage fundraising
Scaling engineering teams

A Note

We are looking for someone who can distinguish between what is technologically impressive and what is commercially necessary.

About The Department

George Mason University has experienced rapid growth over the past several years, resulting in R1 classification, a significant increase in invention disclosures, and a growing portfolio of maturing technologies. With the continued expansion of the regional innovation ecosystem and numerous technology-driven companies in Northern Virginia, the University is advancing its technology transfer and commercialization infrastructure.

The Office of Technology Transfer sits in Mason Enterprise, part of the Office of Research, Innovation, and Economic Impact, which leads university-wide efforts related to innovation, commercialization, entrepreneurship, and industry engagement. The University continues to build a more holistic innovation and business development function to better serve faculty and student innovators, deepen industry partnerships, and contribute to the region’s entrepreneurial ecosystem.

About The Position

The Senior Director, Technology Transfer supports the Office of Research, Innovation, and Economic Impact's growth. This position reflects a refined, execution-focused leadership model while maintaining strategic responsibility for technology transfer across the University. The Senior Director will play a critical role in translating George Mason’s research discoveries into societal and economic impact through intellectual property protection, commercialization, industry engagement, and startup support. This position fits within George Mason’s highly collaborative and inclusive culture and strongly supports the University’s commitment to research commercialization and entrepreneurship.

The Senior Director, Technology Transfer leads the University’s efforts to facilitate the transfer of research discoveries and innovations for public use and benefit. The Senior Director establishes and implements strategies, tools, and procedures to evaluate, protect, market, and commercialize technologies developed by faculty and students. The position has responsibility for technology transfer across all George Mason University campuses.

This role requires independent decision-making authority that substantially affects business operations. The Senior Director reports to the Associate Vice President for Innovation and Economic Development and works closely with faculty, university leadership, legal counsel, industry partners, investors, and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Technology Transfer & Intellectual Property Management:

Lead and oversee the assessment, protection, and management of intellectual property, including inventions, software, data, and other research outputs;
Guide patenting and IP strategy in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel;
Oversee the evaluation of invention disclosures for commercial potential and prioritize technologies for investment and advancement;
Lead negotiation and execution of license agreements, option agreements, NDAs, MTAs, and other IP-related contracts; and
Assist the Office of Sponsored Programs and University Counsel with intellectual property clauses in university agreements.

Technology Transfer Operations, Strategy & Team Leadership

Coordinate with the Associate Vice President to lead operational functions and new initiatives aligned with university strategy;
Recommend and implement streamlined procedures, systems, and best practices for technology transfer operations;
Manage staff and build a high-performing team to support invention intake, IP management, licensing, and industry engagement;
Maintain and enhance reporting, project management, and database systems related to commercialization activities;
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and outside counsel; and
Assist the Vice President of Research with George Mason Research Foundation operations.

Compliance, Policy & Stakeholder Communication

Ensure compliance with federal regulations, including Bayh–Dole requirements, conflict-of-interest policies, and reporting obligations;
Communicate technology transfer policies and processes to faculty in a manner that fosters understanding, trust, and collaboration; and
Prepare and present reports to university leadership as required.

Industry Partnerships & Commercialization Strategy

Serve as a liaison between faculty and industry partners to identify and align industry-relevant research opportunities;
Cultivate and manage relationships with corporations, startups, investors, venture capital firms, accelerators, and government agencies; and
Promote George Mason technologies through targeted outreach, meetings, presentations, and strategic partnerships.

Entrepreneurship & Innovation Ecosystem Development

About Moloco:

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads
is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media
is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture)
, the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

Technology is redefining how organizations attract, support, and develop talent. As the Head of People Technology
, you will shape the technology strategy that powers our People organization, ensuring our systems, AI capabilities, and digital experiences enable the business to scale while delivering an exceptional employee experience.

Reporting to the Senior Director of People Enablement, you will lead the People Technology function and define the long-term vision for our AI-first People Technology ecosystem. You will oversee the strategy, governance, and evolution of our technology stack while identifying opportunities to simplify work, leverage AI and automation, and build intuitive employee experiences.

This role is ideal for a builder. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems through technology, rapidly prototyping solutions, and creating AI-powered products and workflows that transform how work gets done. You'll know when to buy, configure, or build technology to deliver the greatest business value, always balancing innovation with simplicity, scalability, and long-term sustainability.

You'll partner closely with cross functional leaders to build a connected, AI-native ecosystem that enables intelligent automation, trusted data, and exceptional employee experiences.

Build an AI-Native People Technology Ecosystem

Build modular architecture that enables new capabilities to be introduced quickly without reengineering the technology stack.

Think Like a Builder
Rapidly prototype, iterate, and ship solutions using AI, APIs, and scripting platforms.
Continuously challenge existing processes and redesign them using AI and automation.
Deliver in short development cycles, balancing speed with quality, governance, and security.
Create reusable products and workflows that scale across the organization.

Accelerate Innovation Through AI & Automation
Design, prototype, and deploy AI-enabled solutions that improve employee experience and operational efficiency.
Balance innovation with governance, simplicity, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

Enable Trusted People Data
Design and own People data architecture, including data models, integrations, governance, and data pipelines.
Establish standards for data quality, security, governance, and compliance across the People Technology ecosystem.

Lead Technology Operations & Vendor Strategy
Establish a disciplined operating model through structured intake, prioritization, sprint planning, and release management.
Own strategic vendor relationships, contracts, product roadmaps, and technology investments.
Continuously evaluate vendor capabilities and emerging technologies to ensure our technology ecosystem evolves alongside business needs.

Build a High-Performing Team
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing People Technology team.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, experimentation, and continuous learning

What You’ll Bring:

10+ years of progressive experience leading People Technology or in Engineering designing systems at scale
Proven success building and developing high-performing technical teams
Demonstrated experience developing and executing multi-year technology strategies that support business growth
Deep expertise with enterprise People technology & ecosystems
Experience leading complex technology implementations, platform optimization initiatives, and organizational change
Strong understanding of HR systems integrations, access controls, reporting, and data integrity practices
Experience supporting compliance, audit, SOX, requirements within HR systems
Demonstrated ability to build partnerships & influence at all levels of the organization
Experience managing enterprise technology vendors and strategic technology investments (experience making build vs buy decisions)
Strong understanding of People processes, employee lifecycle operations, and the role technology plays in enabling exceptional employee experiences
Experience leveraging AI, automation, or emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical organizations
Excellent analytical, communication, and strategic planning skills
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
Ability to handle confidential data with discretion and care

Preferred Qualifications:

Leadership presence with strong collaboration skills; able to articulate a clear problem statement & recommendation and secure buy-in and support from key stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to translate strategic vision into measurable business outcomes
Demonstrated project management and change management skills, familiarity with project management tools / methodologies and a track record of success in bringing highly complex, cross-functional projects to completion
Experience in a scaling growth start up
Can build custom systems (not just SaaS configuration)

Compensation & Benefits

U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits and perks. U.S.-based employees also receive up to 12 scheduled paid holidays per calendar year and one Thrive Day off per quarter. Additionally, all employees have Flexible Time Off (FTO).

The successful candidate may be eligible for a bonus and equity awards. Eligibility and amounts are determined by performance and the terms of the applicable plans.

added.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An Overview Of This Role

As the Senior Director, Global Subject Matter Expertise (SME) Solutions Architecture, you will build and lead GitLab's Subject Matter Expert organization: three regional teams in AMER, EMEA and APJ, each covering Security & Compliance, Platform, Core DevSecOps, and AI & Competitive. This team is the depth layer of GitLab's technical selling model. It wins the most complex opportunities, scales product expertise into the Account SA team, and turns field insight into product direction.

This is a leader of leaders role. You will manage three regional SME Managers, not individual contributors, and develop them as leaders in their own right. The SME organization is new, so we are looking for a transformational leader who thrives in ambiguity, builds structure where none exists, and has a track record of standing up high-performing technical teams in fast-growing, evolving businesses.

You will work as a peer to GitLab's regional Solutions Architecture Senior Directors and partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Product Marketing and Sales Operations. Together you will make sure GitLab brings the right depth to the right opportunities, and that what the field learns shapes what GitLab builds next.

What You'll Do

Set the strategy, operating model and global standards for the SME organization, aligned to the VP Global SA and GitLab's go-to-market plan.
Build the resourcing model from product-level bookings and consumption targets. Size each product group by region based on where the plan needs specialist coverage.
Act as the field's senior partner to Product Management and Engineering. Run a structured feedback loop that shapes roadmap, launch readiness and early-access programs.
Hire, mentor and develop regional SME Managers and, through them, the full global team.
Own the engagement model with the regional SA Senior Directors, Post-Sales SAs and Customer Success: triage rules, coverage thresholds, the closed-won handoff to Post-Sales SAs, and escalation paths.
Create and improve upon the processes, metrics and KPIs for SME-led technical evaluations, workshops, demos and Proofs of Value.
Partner with CRO staff, regional sales leaders and AVPs on product-category performance, forecast risk and competitive strategy.
Partner with Enablement to drive field readiness for new product launches with Product Marketing and Enablement, including Duo Agent Platform, security and platform offerings.
Build strong relationships with key customers at the technical sponsor and executive level.
Use AI to change how the team works, including deal research, demo creation, PoV automation and knowledge sharing.
Drive organizational transformation by finding gaps early, building structure where none exists, and leading change without waiting for top-down direction.

What You'll Bring

5+ years second-line leadership experience (managing managers) in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering or a technical specialist organization.
Experience building or scaling a specialist, overlay or global SA team in enterprise SaaS, DevSecOps, security or developer tools.
A record of tying technical-team design to bookings and consumption outcomes, with the data to show it.
The ability to lead through ambiguity and rapid organizational change, bringing clarity and direction while strategy is still forming.
Strong relationships with Product and Engineering leaders, and a history of shaping roadmap from field insight.
Fluency across the software development lifecycle, application security (SAST, DAST, SCA), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes and AI-assisted development, including LLM evaluation and production deployment patterns.
Executive presence with technical practitioners, managers and C-level stakeholders.
Proven ability to partner across Sales, Partners, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success and Professional Services.
A self-starting, entrepreneurial approach. You don't wait for a playbook; you write it.

How You'll Be Measured

Global product-category commit attainment and consumption growth.
Time from technical win to first workload in customer’s production environment on SME-engaged opportunities compared with non-engaged opportunities.
SME coverage and engagement speed on the top 10% of opportunities.
Account Team capability lift: fewer escalations and more deals handled without an SME over time.
Product impact: field sentiment on the product feedback process along with field-sourced requirements adopted into the roadmap.
Team health: hiring against plan, manager development, engagement and retention.

About The Team

The Subject Matter Expertise (SME) organization is part of GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, a trusted technical partner for the field. SMEs bring the deepest product expertise to GitLab's most complex opportunities and carry customer feedback into conversations about product direction, enablement and value messaging. The team is distributed and all-remote, and relies on clear communication, strong judgment and shared operating practices across regions.
