We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of more elegant and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? You have to ask yourself...do you feel like making an impact?

About The Team

As a Product Director
on the Virtual Card team, you will lead the core platform and underlying capabilities that power our virtual cards and digital wallets. You’ll set the long-term vision for this space, looking around corners to anticipate where payments are headed so we can build the necessary backend capabilities well before they hit the critical path.

You will own performance across the full spend lifecycle—from card creation and authorization to settlement and post-disruption updates like network account updaters. Because our platform connects with more than a dozen internal and external systems, you’ll focus on building modular, flexible capabilities that let other teams launch features quickly, while continuously simplifying our processes and leveraging AI tools to drive team efficiency and speed up delivery.

In this role, you will build and lead a team of product managers, establish a multi-year capability roadmap, and partner heavily across our engineering and business orgs. Your success will come down to balancing complex technical dependencies with commercial priorities, ensuring our platform is resilient, scalable, and ready for whatever comes next.

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

We want you if you are:

Intellectually Curious. You’re comfortable navigating between the big ideas and executional realities to create an achievable strategic Product Vision. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.
Communicator & Influencer. You’re comfortable influencing a group of executives as well as communicating your product vision clearly to your associates and partners. You can be open to different communication styles and listen carefully to diverse sets of ideas.
A Do-er. You’re biased toward action, and are willing to make commitments and trade-offs with other leaders to remove impediments for your team; you are a leader obsessed with delivering valuable in an iterative way focusing in minimum viable product
Passionate & Customer Focused. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs and build long lasting relationships.
A Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when exploring unknown technologies; you will seek for internal solutions before building new
A Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You are also able to coach others and be a mentor in product development.

Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 5 years of Product Management experience

MBA or Master’s degree

Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer-facing digital products
Experience driving first-time user conversion and monthly active user growth at scale within a large enterprise environment

Bringing to bear deep field exposure and strong external relationships, you will help NVIDIA secure, structure, and deliver LPS assets that unlock next-generation AI capacity!

Own end-to-end LPS site strategy across targeted regions, from early scouting and feasibility through site control and shell delivery.
Lead evaluation of complex land and power opportunities, including transmission/distribution constraints, interconnection timelines, and long-term scalability of each site.
Partner with data center developers, utilities, architects, and construction teams to build and complete powered shell programs aligned with NVIDIA’s technical and capacity requirements.
Navigate permitting, zoning, and local collaborator dynamics to de-risk timelines and accelerate path to power and build-ready status.
Develop and maintain strong relationships across the data center ecosystem (utilities, ISPs, developers, operators, and local partners) to improve NVIDIA’s leverage and deal flow.
Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to internal leadership on site prioritization, tradeoffs, and investment decisions for LPS assets.

Bachelors Degree within a relevant area or equivalent experience in practice.
15+ overall years of experience in land, power, and data center or large-scale infrastructure development dedicated to hardware and physical systems, with direct experience in site strategy and execution.
7+ years of experience in building, training and managing teams.
Practical understanding of power procurement and delivery, permitting, and the physical realities of complex data center sites (access, easements, grid constraints, cooling implications).
Ability to engage credibly with data center builders, utilities, site developers, and local authorities, translating technical and commercial requirements into aligned execution plans.
Experience with architecture, engineering, or construction for critical facilities is highly valued.

Proven track record operating in fast-growing, ambiguous environments and influencing cross-functional teams and external partners.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to “pressure-test” assumptions in the field and bring back clear insights to NVIDIA’s infrastructure and leadership teams

added.title: Senior Director, Customer Health & Critical Accounts
added.description:
The Role

MongoDB is building two connected capabilities that determine how we protect and grow our most important customer relationships: a Critical Accounts program that catches at-risk accounts early and drives them to a durable resolution, and a Customer Health Platform, an AI-powered one-stop shop for customer insights, combining health, adoption, engagement, and experience data with proactive risk identification and recommended actions.

This role owns both. You will build and lead the Critical Accounts function end to end: the framework, the global operating model, and the executive reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio. You will also set the long-term vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform: what it scores and alerts on, which teams and use cases it serves next, and how it becomes the one-stop shop for customer insight across the company. You will be accountable for how MongoDB identifies, intervenes on, and learns from customer risk, and for where the Customer Health platform goes next.

This is a build role. You are creating the operating rhythm, the standards, and the team structure as much as you are running them.

This role can be based out of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What You Will Do

Own and Build the Critical Accounts Program

Design and iterate on the global Critical Accounts framework: entry/exit criteria, account archetypes, playbooks, health assessment templates, and Get Well Plan standards.
Design the central Critical Accounts org structure and hire a lean program management team, establishing this as a durable, well-resourced function within Customer Strategy. This team is the connective tissue that ensures every qualifying account is triaged, resourced, tracked, and ultimately graduated with documented outcomes.
Own intake and triage standards so every qualifying nomination is validated, classified, and assigned a process lead and resource plan without delay.
Design the path for Critical Accounts to move beyond human nomination alone, working with Customer Health to define the signals and thresholds that proactively detect at-risk accounts and surface them for the cohort, so nominations come from both human judgment and the platform's early-warning detection.
Own program coordination: the master tracker of active critical accounts, cross-functional stand-ups with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Product and Engineering, the 90-day checkpoint process, and resource rebalancing as account needs evolve.
Own executive reporting for the program: weekly account status, monthly portfolio readouts with trend analysis, and quarterly summaries covering program KPIs, churn prevented, and cost-to-save ratios.
Set and track program KPIs, de-escalation rate, time-to-exit, CSAT delta, churn prevented, resource hours per account, and refine investment tiers based on actual data.
Lead post-mortem reviews for every graduated account and route findings into QBRs, product prioritization, and process improvements, ensuring learnings reach the business within one quarter of exit.

Lead Customer Intelligence & AI

Own the multi-year vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform, defining what it becomes beyond a Customer Success tool: the single, trusted platform for customer insight that every GTM function draws on to understand and act on customer signal
Set the roadmap priorities for expanding Customer Health's reach: new data sources, new use cases, and new next-best-action and AI-driven experiences
Make the platform-level calls on scope, sequencing, and investment as Customer Health scales across functions, as we as align with cross-functional executives on the path forward
Ensure Customer Health and the Critical Accounts program reinforce each other: account health scores and signals should feed directly into critical account identification, triage, Get Well Plans, and portfolio reporting.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Marketing, and GTM on how Customer Health orchestrates and surfaces insight: who gets alerted about which issues, when, and through which channel (internal vs. external), and how health data and alerts show up in the comms and UI layer for account teams, customers, and partners.

Provide Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the connective tissue across Customer, Product & Technology, Engineering, and GTM leadership for everything related to customer risk, intelligence, and intervention.
Give executives real-time, high-trust visibility into both the Critical Accounts and Customer Health portfolio

What You Will Bring

12+ years in Customer Success, Program Management, or Customer/GTM Operations, ideally in a consumption-based or B2B SaaS company, with several years in a people-management or senior program leadership role.
A track record of building a program or function from the ground up, not just running an existing one, including designing frameworks, standing up teams, and establishing executive reporting.
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements under pressure; direct experience with a critical accounts, save, or escalation management program is strongly preferred.
Experience managing people leaders or senior individual contributors, with the judgment to set direction and hold others accountable without needing to run every workstream personally.
Strong cross-functional leadership without direct authority, and the ability to align Director- and VP-level peers across functions to a shared plan.
Executive-grade written and verbal communication; comfort presenting portfolio health, program KPIs, and business cases to senior leadership and, at times, the board.
Data-driven approach to management: builds and tracks KPIs rather than relying on status updates, and is comfortable reasoning about scoring, health signals, or model-driven recommendations even without an engineering background.
Familiarity with technical customer challenges (cloud, data infrastructure, or database preferred) and with how account teams actually work day to day.
High composure in high-stakes, ambiguous situations, with a bias toward bringing decisions and solutions rather than problems.

Nice to Have

Experience building and managing a Critical Accounts or similar escalation/save function, from designing entry/exit criteria and playbooks through running the portfolio day to day.
Experience owning or sponsoring an AI-powered customer intelligence, account health, or GTM tooling initiative spanning multiple functions.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

added.title: Senior Director, Product Management
added.description:
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About The Team

The Risk Management Product team is seeking an experienced Product leader to lead the strategic transformation of our Credit and Financial Risk Management technology platforms. You will be part of a dynamic team that is on a mission to redesign how we manage risk. We will leverage technology and AI to make our risk management more nimble and lower risk at the time.

You will be a key member of the Credit and Financial Risk Management leadership team. You will lead a team of Product Managers, partnering closely with Engineering and Design to drive results. In this role, you will gain exposure to some of the key risk management processes and decision makers at Capital One. You will be involved with enabling change that will touch every line of business at Capital One and ensuring that we do so with excellence - combining innovation, user experience, and well managed outcomes.

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 7 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

This leader owns the engineering function responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade AI agents, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform how teammates and clients interact with the Firm.

This is a highly technical player-coach leadership role that combines executive organizational leadership with deep hands-on engineering expertise. The Senior Director leads the engineering function, establishes technical direction, drives work planning and execution, and serves as the ultimate escalation point for architecture and engineering decisions across the agentic engineering portfolio.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience building large-scale software and AI systems, including expertise in Python, modern systems languages such as Go, agentic frameworks, LLM orchestration, retrieval architectures, and enterprise AI platform engineering. This leader will be responsible for shipping production agentic systems, not simply defining roadmaps, ensuring all solutions meet Truist standards for security, scalability, resiliency, observability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

The Senior Director partners closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Risk, and executive leadership teams to translate business strategy into enterprise-scale AI capabilities while building and mentoring a world-class team of agentic engineers.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

Lead the Agentic Engineering function, providing executive leadership, organizational design, technical governance, delivery accountability, and talent leadership across all agentic engineering initiatives.
Own the technical direction for Forge agentic solutions, establishing architecture standards, engineering patterns, and development practices for enterprise AI agents and multi-agent systems.
Drive work planning, prioritization, execution management, and delivery outcomes across the agentic engineering organization, ensuring teams consistently deliver high-quality production systems aligned to business commitments.
Serve as the final engineering authority for architecture decisions, engineering standards, and critical code review escalations across the agentic engineering portfolio.
Design and govern enterprise patterns for agent orchestration, tool invocation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory management, prompt architecture, workflow automation, reasoning frameworks, evaluation pipelines, observability, and operational support.
Lead the engineering strategy for enterprise agent platforms including Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and other emerging agentic technologies required to support the Forge roadmap.
Partner with Product, Technology, Security, Risk, Architecture, and Data leaders to ensure AI solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.
Build and mentor a high-performing engineering organization through hiring, performance management, succession planning, coaching, career development, and technical leadership.
Establish and enforce engineering excellence standards including software craftsmanship, testing strategies, release management, architecture review, secure development practices, operational readiness, and reliability engineering.
Drive engineering execution across complex cross-functional initiatives involving application engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, cyber security, and enterprise architecture teams.
Champion engineering rigor through measurable quality controls, system reliability objectives, operational metrics, and continuous improvement practices.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, models, and engineering approaches, identifying opportunities to accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and strengthen enterprise capabilities
Represent Agentic Engineering in executive governance forums, architecture review boards, risk committees, vendor engagements, regulatory discussions, and industry working groups.
Manage organizational budgets, vendor relationships, workforce planning, engineering tooling investments, and resource allocation to support strategic objectives.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and responsible AI development across the organization

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent education, training and work-related experience.
Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in technology operations.
Broad leadership and management experience leading complex technology operations teams.
Proven ability to manage complex operational initiatives across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading enterprise Agentic Engineering, AI Platform Engineering, Applied AI, Intelligent Automation, or Emerging Technology organizations.
Deep expertise in multi-agent systems, agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, reasoning architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory systems, agent evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Experience building production AI applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Agent Engine, or similar platforms.
Experience operating enterprise-scale AI platforms supporting thousands of users and mission-critical business processes.
Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI principles, AI security controls, and enterprise AI operating models.
Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards, mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders, and build a culture of technical excellence.
Experience delivering solutions across cloud-native ecosystems using Azure and modern DevOps, platform engineering, and software delivery practices.
Experience driving architecture modernization and transformation initiatives within large enterprises.
Experience in financial services, fintech, cybersecurity, or other heavily regulated industries.
Demonstrated participation in industry forums, technology communities, open-source initiatives, vendor partnerships, or executive technology councils.

added.description:
Director of Technology Operations & Assurance

Location:
San Diego, CA — In Office
Employment:
Full-Time
Reports to:
CEO
Works closely with:
Chief Architect/CTO and Director of Engineering & AI Product Development

The Mission

Create the operating discipline and independent verification system around the technology organization.

Engineering builds the technology.

You make sure leadership knows what was promised, whether it was delivered, whether it works, whether it is documented, and where risk exists.

Your operating model is:

Commitment → Owner → Date → Verification → QA → Documentation → Risk → CEO Visibility

You are not responsible for building the company's software or managing engineers.
You are responsible for making technology execution visible, accountable, testable and resilient
.

What You Own

Technology Program Governance

Maintain the company's single source of truth for technology execution.
Every meaningful initiative should have:
Defined objective
Accountable owner
Deliverables
Dependencies
Committed dates
Current status
Risks
Blockers
Acceptance criteria
Definition of done

You do not decide how engineering builds something.

You make sure commitments are explicit and measurable.

Problems should surface before deadlines are missed.

Independent QA & Release Assurance

Own the verification layer between:

"Engineering says it's finished"

and

"The company has verified that it works."

Establish processes for:
QA
Acceptance testing
Regression testing
Release verification
Production validation
Defect tracking
Post-release verification

Engineering owns building and fixing the software.

Technology Operations owns independently determining whether it meets the agreed requirements.

A project is not complete because code exists.
It is complete when it meets its acceptance criteria and works in production.

Documentation & Key-Person Risk

Make sure critical company technology does not exist only inside someone's head.
Establish documentation requirements covering:
System architecture
Infrastructure
Databases
Data flows
APIs
AI agents
Repositories
Deployment procedures
Environments
Integrations
Vendors
Access requirements
Technical decisions
Runbooks
Recovery procedures

Engineering creates and maintains technical documentation.

You verify that required documentation exists, is current and can actually be used by another qualified person.

Security Governance & Operational Resilience

Establish visibility and accountability around:
Infrastructure access
Credentials and permissions
Source-code repositories
Production environments
Data security
Vendors
Backup and recovery
Business continuity
Incident response
Security policies
Technical risk

You are not expected to personally operate every security system.
You ensure appropriate controls exist, ownership is clear and material risks are surfaced.

Technology Risk

Maintain a technology risk register covering areas such as:
Key-person dependency
Security exposure
Infrastructure concentration
Undocumented systems
Vendor dependency
Data risks
Production instability
Recovery capability
Technical operational risk

Escalate material risks directly to leadership.

CEO Technology Visibility

Create a simple executive technology dashboard that answers:
What are we building?

Who owns it?

When was it promised?

What's at risk?

What's blocked?

What shipped?

Did it pass QA?

Does it work in production?

Is it documented?

The CEO should not have to chase engineers for answers.

What You Do NOT Own

You do not
own:
Writing production software
Engineering architecture
Engineering implementation
Managing software engineers
Assigning engineering resources
Code reviews
Choosing frameworks
Building AI agents
Technical product development
Resolving engineering problems yourself

Those responsibilities belong to the Director of Engineering and Chief Architect/CTO.

Your role is to measure, verify, challenge, document and escalate—not become a shadow engineering department.

First 90 Days

First 30 Days:
Map projects, commitments, systems, ownership, access, documentation, security exposure and key-person risks. Establish the technology source of truth.

By Day 60:
Implement delivery reporting, QA standards, acceptance criteria, documentation requirements, risk tracking and CEO reporting.

By Day 90:
Establish a repeatable Technology Assurance operating system providing independent visibility into whether engineering is delivering working, documented and resilient technology.

How Success Is Measured

Can leadership see exactly what engineering is working on?
Are commitments and dates explicit?
Are missed commitments identified early?
Does released technology pass independent verification?
Are defects being identified systematically?
Is critical technology documented?
Is key-person dependency decreasing?
Are security risks visible?
Are operational risks being addressed?
Can leadership understand technology status without chasing engineers?

Your job is to create accountability and assurance without creating bureaucracy.

added.title: Director, Mission Engineering Department
added.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Enterprise Effects Division (EED) drives integration of Aerospace’s strategic capabilities across the national space enterprise. The division leverages a broad array of engineering disciplines against dynamic portfolio of programs, customers, and national challenges. EED spans the capability lifecycle from concept and architecture design to performance assessment to application of space and space-enabled capabilities.

As part of the Enterprise Design Subdivision (EDS), the Mission Engineering Department provides technical expertise and leadership in mission engineering methods, processes, and tools to a wide range of customers, including National Security Space (NSS), defense programs, NASA, NOAA, NNSA, and others. The department evaluates customer mission-integration needs, develops end-to-end mission threads, and offers recommendations to enterprise leaders on risks, issues, and gaps, ultimately developing solutions to achieve desired mission outcomes. The Director of the Mission Engineering Department will lead these efforts, build partnerships with customers, and ensure the team is staffed with top talent to solve complex challenges.

Work Model:

This full-time position requires 100% onsite work in El Segundo CA, Chantilly, VA, or Colorado Springs, CO.

What You’ll Be Doing:  

Develop and execute the vision for the department, enhancing corporate capabilities to support customer architecture, systems-of-systems, and enterprise decisions.
Scale the department’s capabilities through recruiting, onboarding, and developing staff via performance management, mentoring, and coaching.
Ensure the Mission Engineering Department and related corporate activities fully leverage expertise from across Aerospace, incorporating best practices in enterprise systems engineering.
Manage the department, including staff performance reviews, resource allocation, and personnel management, and recommend performance improvements, career development, personnel actions, and awards.
Serve as the primary contact for program office inquiries, using mission engineering principles to define problem spaces, develop implementation plans, and identify appropriate personnel based on expertise.
Foster a culture of innovation and collaboration, maintain robust relationships with peer organizations, and lead multi-discipline analyst teams.
Identify new partnerships for future mission engineering growth in customer impact.
Coordinate and manage complex technical tasks among customers, ensuring quality and accuracy of work products.
Collaborate with subdivision leadership to cultivate an effective national organization.
Lead technical activities, organize project teams, and execute a variety of architecture conceptualization, assessment, analysis, and mission engineering activities.

What You Need to be a Successful Director, Mission Engineering Department

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, physics, operations research, mathematics, or a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution and equivalent technical experience
Typically 10 or more years demonstrated experience leading engineering studies and analysis teams, managing/coordinating complex technical tasks among team members, and translating customer needs into actionable tasks for analysts
Demonstrated leadership of multidisciplinary teams involving system design, acquisition and/or operations in one or more of the following areas: space systems, ground systems, launch systems, or operations
Experience in hiring, supervising, developing, mentoring, and inspiring staff
Proven ability to initiate and lead project teams, develop project plans, identify high-impact deliverables, and manage schedule commitments
Exceptional time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and to lead cross-functional teams
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to present methods and results effectively
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, adapt quickly to change, manage ambiguity, and demonstrate initiative under pressure
Ability to travel approximately 15-25% of the time
This position requires a current and active TS/SCI clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government, and the ability to pass a CI Polygraph. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

How You Can Stand Out  

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these: 

A graduate degree or extensive work experience relevant fields
Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) and/or digital engineering
Experience collaborating with multiple Aerospace program offices and customers
Strong interpersonal networks within Aerospace and customer organizations
Military operations experience in the space, air, land, or sea domains
Experience with Intelligence Community systems engineering and programmatic processes

The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. added.title: Senior Manager or Director, Engineering
added.description:
A note on level:

We're evaluating this role at both the Senior Engineering Manager and Director of Engineering level, depending on the candidate's experience and readiness. The scope and core responsibilities described below are the same either way — what differs is title, seniority expectations, and compensation, which will be discussed directly during the interview process. For someone joining as Senior Engineering Manager, there is a path to Director as they grow into the full scope of the role.

About The Role

The growth is proven. Stratus has built a platform customers depend on and a market that is accelerating. The next chapter is scale and compounding value: more customers, deeper workflows, and an AI layer that gives MEP fabrication shops capabilities they could not build on their own.

You will be among the first engineering leaders to put a genuine AI agent into a fabrication workflow that a real shop floor runs on. That has not been done at scale. This role is where it gets built. And you will build it while keeping the core product shipping to a rapidly growing customer base. You will need to hold both.

You will report to the CTO, peer with Directors and Senior Directors across engineering, and partner day to day with the Head of Product and GTM leadership. This role is fully remote. We meet quarterly as a leadership team and make regular visits to customer shop floors. You will know what your software looks like when it is running in a real fabrication environment.

Lead product focused teams delivering against the Stratus roadmap, bringing engineering and AI capability together to ship what customers depend on.

We are early in this build and you will shape how it goes.

This is a lean, senior-IC-adjacent role: the person in this seat is expected to be the anchor — consistently available during core working hours, with occasional availability for production escalations outside business hours (realistically once a month or less, not frequent late nights.)

MEP industry experience is a strong plus.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Customers notice the difference: core platform improvements and AI capabilities that address real workflow problems, solutions that fabrication shops come back for and build their operations around.
AI shipped to production that sticks. Not a proof of concept. Something a shop floor runs on.
Teams that raise their delivery bar consistently and a team stronger than when you found it.
A seat earned in the architecture conversations that shape the platform because you brought engineering judgment and customer insight in equal measure.

What You Will Own

Engineering delivery. Own what ships. Lead PODs that build solutions customers notice and rely on. Favor working software and live demos over status decks. Set the cadence, clear the path, hold the bar.
Customer empathy and connection. Your customers work on a fabrication shop floor. Getting close to them means product conversations, design reviews grounded in real workflows, and staying present when a production issue reaches a customer. Build genuine understanding of what they are trying to accomplish and let that shape how your teams think and build.
Product solutioning. Work alongside Product and users to translate real workflow problems into solutions that stick. The solutions you build will be used on a shop floor by someone who needs them to work every time. Bring engineering judgment to what gets built: knowing when a targeted feature solves the problem, when a deeper architectural change is what is actually needed, and when the right answer is to simplify rather than add.
Technical architecture partnership. Work with the CTO and engineering leadership on platform decisions across our Azure and MongoDB Atlas stack and the move toward agentic surfaces. Full partner in the decisions and fully accountable for how your teams deliver them.
AI era engineering culture. Every stage of the development cycle, from a design whiteboard to a production deploy, should have AI making the team faster and the output better. You build that culture and you go first.
Engineering standards. Leaves the codebase, the process, and the people in better shape than you found them: CI/CD, code review culture, observability, and incident learning treated as foundations, not afterthoughts.
Cross-functional execution. Partner with Product, Data, and Customer Success to ship what customers depend on. Bring what you learn in the field back into how your teams build.

What You Bring

AI forward and pragmatic engineering. Has led a team shipping AI-enabled product features that customers depend on in production, or has otherwise demonstrated strong, hands-on AI/ML depth and sound judgment about where AI adds real value. Agentic-specific experience is a strong plus but not required. Knows what it takes to keep AI reliable in production, makes the right build versus buy call, and focuses on shipping AI customers trust rather than infrastructure for its own sake.
Technical depth. Cloud native SaaS architecture with Azure experience preferred. Comfortable in C# or .NET. MongoDB or document database experience is a plus. "Hands-on" here means staying close to the work — engaging in design reviews, working through technical roadblocks with engineers, and participating in PRs — not necessarily writing production code day to day.
Experience. 10 or more years in software engineering, ideally including experience building and shipping AI-enabled products, with 5 or more in engineering leadership at a SaaS product company (for Director-level candidates; somewhat less leadership tenure may be appropriate for candidates joining at the Senior Engineering Manager level with a path to Director). Has shipped in an environment where the customer base was growing fast enough that a bad release had real consequences. Has taken on a team, nurtured it to higher impact and done it without losing what was already working. Has hired at least one person who became exceptional and can explain exactly why.
Delivery discipline. Real planning, tracking, and follow-through — knows how to hit dates or surface risk early, rather than discovering a miss after the fact. This is the single biggest gap we're solving for with this hire.
Customer and product orientation. Can sit in a customer conversation, find the real problem beneath the stated request, and carry that signal back to the teams. Thinks first about what outcome the customer needs, then about how to deliver it. Measures success in value shipped, not tasks completed.
Leadership experience, including strong communication skills and ability to work with a distributed team and cross functional teams.
Domain (strong plus). MEP, fabrication, or construction technology experience lets you challenge product and architecture decisions with domain intuition and build customer credibility faster.

Nice to Have

Experience with Autodesk or similar
Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, or field operations software.
Hands on experience with LangGraph, MCP, or agentic orchestration frameworks.

Benefits

Comprehensive and competitive health benefits plan
Matching 401k contributions
20 days annual PTO
Primarily remote work with occasional annual team onsites.

E-VERIFY STATEMENT

Stratus participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

Howmet Fastening Systems is looking for a Director of Operations to provide overall leadership to the fastener installation tooling manufacturing facility located in Kingston, NY

Howmet Aerospace Inc. (NYSE: HWM), headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, is a leading global provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries. Our primary businesses focus on jet engine components, aerospace fastening systems, titanium structural parts and forged wheels. With $7.4 Billion in revenue in 2024, our products play a crucial role in enabling fuel efficiency and lightweighting, contributing to our customers’ success and making a positive impact on the world. To learn more about the way Howmet Aerospace Inc. is advancing the sustainability of our customers, markets, and communities where we operate, review the 2024 Environmental Social and Governance report at www.howmet.com/esg-report . Follow: LinkedIn , Twitter , Instagram , Facebook , and YouTube .

Born from many well-known and long-standing brands, Howmet Fastening Systems, headquartered in Torrance, California, is the premier designer and manufacturer of aerospace and industrial fasteners, latches, fluid fittings and installation tools. Our products are used nose to tail on commercial and military aircraft, as well as on jet engines, industrial gas turbines, automobiles, commercial transportation vehicles, wind turbines, solar power systems, and construction and industrial equipment.

Specific Duties

Develops annual revenue and manufacturing plan in consultation with other senior-level unit leaders to ensure proper deployment of resources to achieve required levels of production and to meet customer delivery requirements.

Interfaces directly with key customers, in concert with Sales & Marketing Management and Account Managers to resolve problems related to delivery, quality and other issues.Strives to address customer concerns in a responsive, professional manner while protecting the interests of the Company.
Coordinates activities with other departments such as Sales & Marketing, Engineering/R&D, Purchasing, Accounting, Information Systems, and Human Resources.Secures required resources and consultative support from staff units as required.
Continually improves the performance of the Manufacturing organization through the application of CI principles to drive down costs and improve location profitability.This includes the application of specific techniques such as kaizen rapid improvement events and the development of a Continuous Improvement mindset within the Manufacturing organization.
Participates with Purchasing personnel to develop partnerships with vendors which produce mutually beneficial arrangements related to purchased item quality and pricing. Ensures that concerns and issues related to purchased resources are addressed and resolved in a timely manner.
Interacts positively and effectively with personnel, both internal and external to the organization. added.title: Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering
added.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering will lead a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and developers to design and deploy enterprise-scale optimization and decision-intelligence solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role combines strategic vision with hands-on technical leadership, serving as an enterprise subject matter expert for machine learning, optimization and mathematical programming while guiding teams to deliver production-ready systems that enhance business performance and guest experiences. Key responsibilities include managing a portfolio of applied AI/ML initiatives across personalization, marketing, dynamic pricing, revenue management, workforce planning, digital experiences, and other complex decision domains; translating strategy into execution; embedding responsible AI and decision-system practices; and fostering a culture of innovation. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative leader, committed to developing talent, championing technical rigor, and enabling AI,ML and optimization at scale across the organization.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Leadership & Enterprise Enablement

Provide strategic and technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and developers, setting direction and aligning work to enterprise priorities while promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and high-impact delivery.
Establish and communicate a clear enterprise vision, technical roadmap, and operating model for optimization and decision intelligence, balancing immediate business needs with long-term capability development.
Direct technical teams by defining objectives, decision rights, technical standards, architectural guardrails, and measurable outcomes.
Guide and mentor technical teams through problem formulation, architecture, model design, solution trade-offs, and production readiness in support of machine learning, optimization and mathematical programming.
Coordinate initiative sequencing, resource needs, dependencies, and delivery risks across product, engineering, data, and business teams, removing roadblocks and ensuring execution remains aligned with scope, schedule, and business outcomes.

Applied AI/ML & Optimization Development

Provide technical direction and oversight for AI/ML and optimization development, architecture, code quality, reusable libraries, reference architectures, and product-lifecycle best practices to ensure scalable, maintainable, secure, and production-ready solutions.
Engage with internal and external partners to gather requirements and collaborate with engineers, architects, product leaders, and business stakeholders to design robust solutions across domains.
Lead end-to-end problem formulation, model design, algorithm selection, prototyping, benchmarking, and validation across optimization, machine learning, and decision science. Apply advanced analytical and AI/ML techniques to integrate predictive and prescriptive modeling, experimentation, simulation, real-time signals, and business constraints into scalable decision systems that improve business outcomes and adapt over time.
Establish delivery and operational governance, remove cross-team roadblocks, and track quality, reliability, adoption, and business-impact KPIs. Define standards for model and solver monitoring, performance degradation and drift detection, incident response, and continuous improvement.

AI/ML Technical Strategy

Define and drive the strategy and prioritized portfolio for optimization products and decision systems, balancing near-term business outcomes with long-term platform evolution and determining where capabilities should be built, bought, reused, or standardized across personalization, marketing, dynamic pricing, revenue management, workforce planning, digital experiences, and resource allocation.
Evaluate open-source and commercial solvers, frameworks, and platforms across performance, cost, scalability, licensing, and security; direct cross-functional alignment on technology choices, investments, standards, and responsible-AI requirements, and communicate recommendations, trade-offs, and program status to senior leadership.
Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Hands-on experience designing and developing production decision systems, including data and feature pipelines, APIs and services, cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, containerization, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining or recalibration processes.
Deep expertise in statistical inference, supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering and segmentation, time-series forecasting, probabilistic modeling, predictive analytics, and model ensembling.
Demonstrated expertise formulating and solving large-scale decision problems using linear, mixed-integer, nonlinear, stochastic, robust, and/or multi-objective optimization; experience with constraint programming, decomposition, simulation, heuristics, and learning-based decision methods.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using optimization modeling frameworks and one or more solver ecosystems such as Gurobi or CPLEX.
Experience integrating optimization with machine learning, forecasting, predictive models, personalization and recommendation systems, experimentation, simulation, or adaptive decision methods.
Proven ability to establish technical vision, influence and direct multidisciplinary teams without formal authority, drive cross-functional alignment, and resolve complex technical and business decisions.
Track record of connecting technical solutions to tangible business value and managing a portfolio of initiatives across multiple business domains.
Storyteller comfortable presenting to executives and mentoring both technical and non-technical audiences.
Hands-on experience applying privacy, security, fairness, explainability, governance, and compliance principles in production AI/ML and optimization systems.
Advanced knowledge of product and delivery methodologies, with demonstrated success translating strategy into coordinated execution in fast-paced, ambiguous, and matrixed environments.

EDUCATION:

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or in a relevant applied quantitative field is required.

EXPERIENCE:

9+ years’ experience in applied‑AI, data science or software‑engineering roles;
or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

added.description:
Brief Description

Passion. Purpose. Impact.
CJP is at the heart of Greater Boston's Jewish community, but our reach is felt around the world. Ranked by BBJ as Massachusetts’ largest non-profit organization – CJP is a philanthropic investor and mobilizer of people, resources, and skills that make a bigger difference locally and globally. We focus on making Jewish life and learning accessible to all individuals and families in Boston and beyond. We thoughtfully invest in the care and well-being of all community members. And we provide stability and growth to nonprofit organizations and institutions that underpin our community. Our greatest resource is our people — the staff, volunteers, partners, and leaders who help make Greater Boston’s Jewish community a welcoming home. It’s this energy and commitment that drive CJP’s mission. We are one of Boston's oldest and most respected philanthropic organizations and we are currently seeking a Vice President, Information Technology.

The Vice President will lead a cross-functional team of IT, data, analytics, operations, and technology professionals and will have responsibility for CJP’s technology ecosystem, including business applications, data and analytics, technical infrastructure, cybersecurity, end-user support, and technology operations

Working closely with senior leadership and stakeholders across CJP, the Vice President will develop and execute a long-term technology roadmap aligned with CJP’s strategic priorities. This leader will play a critical role in advancing CJP’s technology infrastructure and platforms to improve organizational effectiveness, strengthen decision-making, enhance the employee experience, and better serve CJP’s community.

The Vice President will also partner closely with teams across the organization to advance technology solutions supporting fundraising, community engagement, grantmaking, finance, marketing, and communications. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with business acumen, sound judgment, and an ability to build trusted relationships across the organization.

CJP is not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

Essential Functions

Technology Strategy and Leadership

Develop and execute CJP’s long-term technology strategy and roadmap in alignment with organizational priorities and CJP’s multi-year strategic direction.
Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on technology, data, cybersecurity, digital transformation, and emerging technology opportunities.
Assess CJP’s technology environment and identify opportunities to modernize systems, streamline processes, improve integration, and increase organizational effectiveness.
Translate organizational needs and business challenges into scalable technology solutions.
Establish priorities and allocate technology resources to areas of greatest organizational impact.
Stay current on technology trends, emerging solutions, and best practices, particularly those relevant to nonprofit and philanthropic organizations.

Business Systems and Digital Transformation

Lead the planning and implementation of integrated enterprise systems, including CRM, accounting, grants management, and other critical business applications.
Plan, architect, and launch systems, applications, and processes that improve how CJP operates and enhance access to information and data.
Ensure effective integration and interoperability among CJP’s core technology platforms.
Partner with organizational leaders to define business requirements, evaluate technology solutions, and lead successful implementation and adoption.
Identify opportunities to leverage automation, artificial intelligence, process redesign, and other technologies to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
Partner with Development, Marketing, and other teams to support the technology components of CJP’s external-facing digital strategy, including integration between front-end platforms and internal systems.

Data, Analytics, and Governance

Provide strategic leadership for CJP’s data architecture, governance, integration, reporting, and analytics capabilities.
Establish standards and processes that support data quality, integrity, accessibility, security, and responsible use.
Strengthen CJP’s ability to use data and analytics to inform organizational decision-making, measure outcomes, and understand organizational and community impact.
Develop an analytics function that provides leaders with meaningful insights and accessible, reliable information.
Partner across functions to improve data collection, reporting, and organizational adoption of data-driven practices.

IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity

Provide oversight and strategic direction for all aspects of IT operations, including infrastructure, cloud services, business systems, end-user technology, data and analytics, cybersecurity, and technical support.
Ensure a reliable, secure, responsive, and high-quality technology experience for CJP employees.
Develop and maintain a comprehensive information security and cybersecurity program that protects CJP’s systems, information, and technology assets.
Ensure appropriate technology-related compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
Maintain effective technology business continuity, disaster recovery, incident response, and risk-management practices.
Oversee technology vendors, managed service providers, consultants, contracts, and other external partners.

Organizational Partnership and Continuous Improvement

Build strong relationships with executive leadership, department leaders, and staff to understand organizational needs and develop solutions that advance their objectives.
Collaborate across functions including Development, Finance, Marketing, Strategy, Operations, and other areas to support organizational priorities.
Evaluate existing business and technology processes and establish a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.
Define and prioritize complex business challenges, identify potential solutions, and lead successful implementation and organizational adoption.
Communicate technology strategy, priorities, risks, and progress clearly to executive leadership and, as appropriate, CJP's Board and committees.

Team Leadership and Development

Lead, develop, and empower a high-performing, service-oriented technology team.
Build an effective operating model that strategically leverages employees, contractors, consultants, and managed service providers.
Establish clear goals, accountability, and performance expectations for the technology function.
Coach and develop team members while building organizational capabilities, career development opportunities, and succession plans.
Foster a collaborative, responsive, innovative, and solutions-oriented culture.
Strengthen technology fluency and capabilities across CJP by helping employees effectively adopt and use technology tools and systems.
Other duties as assigned with or without accommodation.

Requirements

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree required with emphasis on computer science, information systems, software engineering, or other relevant field.
A Master of Business Administration (MBA) degree with an emphasis on Information Technology is preferred.

Experience

10+ years’ experience building, leading, scaling, and monitoring a Technology function with an emphasis on Cloud infrastructure and SaaS-based applications and services.
Significant experience with cloud infrastructure, SaaS applications, enterprise systems, and modern technology environments.

Skills/Competencies

Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategies aligned with organizational priorities.
Experience leading complex systems implementations and technology transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise applications, data architecture, analytics, systems integration, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and IT operations.
Demonstrated ability to assess a complex technology environment and develop and execute plans to improve operational effectiveness.
Experience selecting, negotiating with, and managing technology vendors, consultants, and managed service providers.
Proven experience leading and developing high-performing technology teams.
Strong project and program management capabilities, with experience managing multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders and sophisticated business users across functions such as fundraising, finance, marketing, strategy, and operations.
Ability to quickly assess complex issues, establish priorities, and make effective decisions in a dynamic environment.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technology concepts to nontechnical audiences and senior-level stakeholders.
Experience working in a nonprofit, philanthropic, mission-driven, or similarly complex organization is preferred.

Other

Ability to travel as needed to events, conferences, etc.

Organizational Relationships/Scope

Reports to Chief Financial and Administrative Officer. Has multiple direct reports.

Working Conditions

Hybrid Work Schedule: CJP staff follow a hybrid work model. On-site work is required on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, while remote work is an option on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays with occasional in-person meetings on those days.
Physical Requirements: This role involves remaining in a stationary position, often sitting or standing for prolonged periods, primarily working at a computer. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds.
Some evening, weekend, or off-hours availability may occasionally be required in connection with critical technology implementations, system maintenance, or incident response.
Inclusivity: We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for individuals of all abilities and backgrounds.

Summary

CJP provides a unique opportunity to leverage your skills, talents, and experience to benefit the greater good while fostering your professional growth. You will work in a dynamic environment with a diverse group of individuals who share your commitment and enthusiasm. Together, we make a difference for both Jews and non-Jews in Greater Boston and worldwide. We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and a supportive, family-friendly work environment.

CJP Core Commitments

CJP is guided by our Core Values— Respect, Caring, Collaboration, Integrity, and Innovation— that ground our work and shape the culture we create together.

For more information about CJP, visit www.cjp.org and https://www.cjp.org/about-us/careers/find-a-job

Equal Opportunity Statement

CJP is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Accommodation Disclaimer

CJP is dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for individuals of all abilities and backgrounds. We provide reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Upon request, reasonable accommodations in the application process will be provided to individuals with disabilities.

CJP conducts background checks as part of the hiring process.

added.title: Senior Engineering Manager
added.description:
Senior Engineering Manager – Checkfront & Regiondo

About The Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the teams responsible for Checkfront and Regiondo, established booking-management products used by thousands of tour, activity, and experience operators.

Checkfront and Regiondo are mature, revenue-generating products with years of functionality and customer needs represented in their codebases. The teams will continue delivering meaningful product improvements while placing increased emphasis on stability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational confidence.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will be accountable for the health, development, performance, and delivery of the engineering teams for both products. You’ll work closely with Product, senior technical contributors and other engineering leaders to establish priorities, make sound tradeoffs, and create an environment in which engineers can effectively work and grow.

We employ a player-coach model for engineering leadership. You won’t be expected to be the team’s primary implementer or sole technical decision maker, and your success will not be measured by your personal output. You will, however, be expected to remain close enough to the work to represent the major systems, architectural decisions, delivery risks, incidents, and operational characteristics across your area. You should be able to explain the technical approach for both teams, participate credibly in engineering discussions, and make high-level decisions.

This is a role for a technical leader who enjoys leading people as well as improving how engineering teams build and deliver quality software.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Develop Teams

Set clear expectations and create an environment of trust, accountability, and respectful collaboration across the Checkfront and Regiondo teams
Hold effective one-on-ones and provide timely, specific, actionable feedback
Support engineers in building meaningful growth plans and developing their careers
Recognize strong performance and address performance concerns directly
Develop senior engineers and emerging technical leaders, creating opportunities for them to take on broader responsibilities
Maintain awareness of team morale, workload, delivery constraints, interpersonal dynamics, and capacity
Participate in hiring and onboarding new team members as the teams evolve

Own Multi-Team Delivery and Operational Outcomes

Partner closely with Product to establish priorities, sequencing, and delivery plans across both products, aligning to the tech organization’s overall goals
Create alignment when teams have shared dependencies, competing priorities, or overlapping ownership
Balance new product development with reliability, maintenance, testing, technical debt, performance, and longer-term engineering health
Surface delivery risks, dependencies, ownership gaps and capacity constraints early
Establish clear ownership and hold teams accountable for delivering work to an appropriate quality standard
Remain actively engaged in production incidents and escalations, understanding their customer impact, contributing factors, and remediation
Maintain accountability for stable, secure deployments and appropriate post-deployment observability

Provide Technical and Operational Leadership

Maintain sufficient technical and operational context across Checkfront and Regiondo to understand their major systems, dependencies, risks, and incidents
Identify opportunities to make team processes and engineering practices more effective
Participate in important technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and help the team make pragmatic tradeoffs
Help the teams improve maintainability, observability, testing, reliability, and overall engineering quality
Ensure that technical investments are connected to meaningful customer, product, operational, or business outcomes
Stay hands-on enough with both team’s work and systems to understand the practical constraints the engineers are working within
Use evidence to understand whether changes to tools or working practices are actually improving team outcomes

What We’re Looking For

Experience successfully leading and developing software engineers in an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager, or comparable engineering leadership role
Experience operating across multiple engineering teams and product areas
Strong people-management skills, including coaching, feedback, career development, expectation setting, and addressing performance concerns
Experience developing senior engineers or technical leaders
A track record of creating accountability without relying on micromanagement
Strong operational instincts, including experience with production incidents, observability, reliability, and learning from recurring failures
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to communicate engineering concerns to Product, Support, leadership, and other stakeholders
An ownership mindset: when something affecting your area is going wrong, you stay engaged until there is clarity around impact, ownership, next steps, and resolution

Nice to Have

Familiarity with some of the technologies used across Checkfront and Regiondo, including PHP, React, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud Platform
Experience working closely with customer-facing teams such as Support or Customer Success
Experience with AI-assisted software-development tools and an interest in applying them pragmatically and responsibly
Experience in booking, ecommerce, travel, tours and activities, or other operationally complex domains
Experience helping teams incrementally modernize complex systems without requiring large-scale rewrites
Experience improving test coverage, deployment automation, incident response, and production observability

added.description:
Role Summary:

A strategic leadership role responsible for defining and driving the digital transformation, automation, and IT/OT integration strategy across the integrated steel plant. The role involves establishing an AI-first operating model, modernizing plant automation and control systems, and building enterprise-wide digital capabilities to enhance operational efficiency, safety, and competitiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Define and lead the enterprise-wide digitalization, automation, and AI strategy for the integrated steel plant, aligned with overall business objectives
Drive integration of Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems across plant operations, including process control, MES, ERP, and enterprise data platforms
Champion the adoption of an AI-first operating model, identifying and implementing AI/ML use cases across operations, maintenance, quality, and supply chain functions
Lead the design and implementation of advanced plant automation systems, including distributed control systems (DCS), SCADA, PLC networks, and industrial IoT platforms
Develop and execute a digital transformation roadmap covering data infrastructure, analytics, cybersecurity, and digital tools for plant and business operations
Partner with plant operations, engineering, and business leadership to identify digitalization opportunities that improve productivity, quality, and cost performance
Build and lead a high-performing digitalization and automation team, including IT, OT, data science, and automation engineering professionals
Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for digital and automation initiatives across the organization
Evaluate and select digital technology partners, automation vendors, and system integrators
Ensure robust cybersecurity practices across IT/OT environments, protecting critical plant infrastructure and data assets
Drive change management initiatives to support digital adoption across the organization
Present digital transformation strategy, progress, and business impact to executive leadership and the board

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline; advanced degree (MBA or technical master's) preferred
Extensive senior leadership experience (typically 25+ years) in IT/OT strategy, digital transformation, and plant automation, preferably within the steel or heavy manufacturing industry
Strong background in steel plant automation, IT/OT integration, digital transformation, and AI adoption
Proven experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation programs at a CIO or equivalent senior leadership level
Deep understanding of manufacturing execution systems (MES), industrial automation, industrial IoT, and enterprise data platforms
Strong knowledge of AI/ML applications in industrial and manufacturing environments
Excellent executive presence, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills
Experience building and leading cross-functional digital, IT, and automation teams
Capable of driving an AI-first operating model across the organization

Working Conditions

Based in the United States, leading digitalization and automation strategy for the Mesabi ISP Project and the broader organization
Travel to plant sites, technology partner locations, and corporate offices as required

Preferred Experience

Prior CIO or equivalent senior digital leadership role within a steel or heavy industrial organization
Experience leading greenfield plant digitalization and automation design from the ground up
Track record of successfully scaling AI adoption across an industrial operating environment
